decisions.reason: Historical OS source with later patches/date support and Model II interrupt-stack fixes. Some utilities are reconstructed listings; retain revision-specific scope rather than whole-TRS-80 compatibility.

decisions.title: HELIX32 — DOS graphics-library reconstruction
decisions.reason: Partial graphics driver/library C++ with MCGA page tables and decompiler-style state names, associated with Blood by repository description. Not the full game engine.

decisions.title: Ultima V Revolutions — Rust engine reconstruction
decisions.reason: Rust translation of DOS executable/overlay logic with original-file input and driver effect routines. User must supply game files; fidelity and all-function claims not independently verified.

decisions.title: BASIC-to-6809 — CoCo/Dragon compiler
decisions.reason: Source-available cross compiler with tokenizer, compiler includes and native runtime helpers. Extends Extended Color BASIC; supported commands/platform variants are upstream claims, not independently tested.

decisions.title: Squanchy BASIC — relocated Color BASIC
decisions.reason: Reassembled Color BASIC family moved to top of RAM on 64K machines, with Extended/Disk variants. Compatibility goal excludes programs depending on original internals; not identical ROM layout.

decisions.title: Basic09 Level 2 development environment
decisions.reason: Modular Basic09 compiler/editor/runtime source with far-memory modules and process-separation goals. F256 target first, CoCo 3 in mind; do not infer every roadmap feature or target already works.

decisions.title: Amiga ILBM/HAM image tools
decisions.reason: IFF/ILBM handling and grayscale/RGB12/HAM conversion algorithms. README explicitly says writing sliced HAM6 ILBM remains unfinished; no complete format-support claim.

decisions.title: rtbinobj — retro object-file converter
decisions.reason: GUI/CLI source includes OMF, COFF, Amiga HUNK and BSV writers. README still says DOS-only, while inspected COFF/HUNK modules establish broader implementation; no independent equivalence tests.

decisions.title: SNDK — SNES SDK and RetroTracker
decisions.reason: Current SDK linked from obsolete Super Kannagi Sound. Higueul-based development and RetroTracker asset/audio tools; planned editor/collision features not assumed complete.

decisions.title: unDRC — DAAD game decompiler
decisions.reason: Current successor for DC 2.0+/DRC games with DDB parsing and DSF export. Original comments/defines cannot be recovered; earliest Aventuras AD files may still need old unDAAD.

decisions.title: LSPX — tracker-to-Amiga music converter
decisions.reason: Current successor to xmtolsp using OpenMPT formats and automatic sample downsampling. Four-channel Amiga limits retained; panning/reverb-style effects are ignored rather than reproduced.

decisions.title: Textalker source placeholder
decisions.reason: Only README and licence present; no implementation source established.

decisions.title: SNES sound-driver documentation viewer
decisions.reason: Design scaffold and tiny generator placeholder do not establish a substantive implemented viewer.

decisions.title: Ristar Mega Drive initial disassembly
decisions.reason: Inspected main source covers header, vectors, error trap and alignment; bulk content remains ROM binaries and IDA database. Retain as early analysis rather than claim substantive source reconstruction.

decisions.title: Metamode initial Game Boy analysis
decisions.reason: Small boot/core listing with unresolved calls and graphics scripts establishes early analysis but not substantial game-code recovery.

decisions.title: Super Kannagi Sound predecessor
decisions.reason: Upstream directs development to SNDK, promoted in this batch. Preserve predecessor relationship rather than add another current SDK identity.

decisions.title: unDAAD predecessor
decisions.reason: Current DC 2.0+/DRC decompilation continues in unDRC, promoted in this batch. Older tool may still be required for earliest Aventuras AD files.

decisions.title: XM to LSP predecessor
decisions.reason: Explicitly superseded by LSPX, promoted in this batch; preserve lineage without a redundant current-tool record.

decisions.title: ZX-M8XXX Spectrum debugger
decisions.reason: Browser emulator and reverse-engineering debugger with coverage, provenance, indirect-jump and call-graph instrumentation. General-purpose tooling, not a game-specific wrapper; broad timing/features remain upstream claims.

decisions.title: SpecConv Spectrum analysis environment
decisions.reason: Interactive emulator/disassembler with coverage, persistent analysis and assembler/C export. README calls most analysis/decompilation features experimental; not proof of automatic complete C recovery.

decisions.title: Subterranean Stryker C# native port
decisions.reason: Separate native SDL2 C# game logic exists alongside an emulator-based frontend. Inspected ship AI implements source-address-traced movement and collisions despite stale STUB header. Historic and modern modes differ; fidelity is not independently tested.

decisions.title: AmigaDOS Ed 1.14 Rust reimplementation
decisions.reason: Behaviour specification and implemented Rust buffer/command editor target Workbench 1.3 Ed, not later C-era Ed. Modern host clone; upstream clean-room/legal claims are not independently certified.

decisions.title: CPC SDCC ROM development template
decisions.reason: Concrete background-ROM startup, RSX table and C entry scaffold for SDCC/Code::Blocks. Small reusable development template, not a new compiler or complete game.

decisions.title: CoCo C development system
decisions.reason: Historical compiler, optimizer, linker, libraries and utilities collection. Inspected code-generation source retains modification history. Keep repository collection whole; tool availability and buildability not independently verified.

decisions.title: Stone Raider II / Dig-It original source
decisions.reason: Author-recovered 1986 source and cave data with modern lwtools adaptation. This is the original Dig-It version, not the lost Microdeal release source. Joystick-only controls and revision distinction retained.

decisions.title: RetroLinker multi-format linker
decisions.reason: Alpha linker/dumper for multiple historical executable formats. Input and output support differ: README limits object input to ELF/COFF/a.out; inspected Apple resource/container handling. Do not infer all formats or architectures work equally.

decisions.title: rtasl.lib ReqTools API reimplementation
decisions.reason: Static ReqTools API compatibility layer backed by ASL/Intuition/GadTools and optional ReAction. Requires application relinking and OpenLibrary changes; not a drop-in runtime reqtools.library replacement.

decisions.title: Camputers Lynx ROM disassembly
decisions.reason: 48K L014 and 96K ROM analysis supplemented by later historical source. Explicit Claude-assisted annotations may be inaccurate. Camputers Lynx, not Atari Lynx; upstream exact-ROM claim not independently reproduced.

decisions.title: Yoshi’s Island SNES disassembly
decisions.reason: US1.0 disassembly with 65816, Super FX and sound code, credited to Raidenthequick and TheGreekBrit. Upstream calls assembly complete but semantic documentation incomplete; clean-ROM claim not independently tested.

decisions.title: A Link to the Past JP1.0 disassembly
decisions.reason: Annotated Japanese1.0 source and asset extractor using Futaba. Credits US disassembly and reused SPC work; not independent authorship of every component. Own ROM required for excluded binary assets.

decisions.title: Jurassic Park SNES disassembly
decisions.reason: USA1.0 source in SNES ROM Framework with asset extraction and readable SPC engine. Headerless original required; no unsupported regional builds or independent matching result claimed.

decisions.title: Puggsy SNES prototype disassembly
decisions.reason: Banked rebuild-oriented disassembly of unreleased SNES version. Mostly address-derived labels and data blocks; substantive listing exists but semantic documentation and build success remain unverified.

decisions.title: Super Mario All-Stars disassembly
decisions.reason: Collection-wide annotated bank source. Upstream explicitly warns relocations or code changes may break the ROM and assembly/documentation remain unfinished; no full relocatability claim.

decisions.title: GYM reader and YM2612 analysis
decisions.reason: Browser GYM event player with custom YM2612 code and WAV export. Source establishes audio-chip investigation despite no README; not a full console emulator or proven sound-accuracy implementation.

decisions.title: satrecomp Saturn recompilation toolkit
decisions.reason: Reusable SH-2 block-to-C++ generator with hardware models and interpreter fallback. Marketing says no emulator, but code/README explicitly retain interpretation and machine models. No public game port yet; reference patch is not public. Not classified as a complete native game.

decisions.title: Zombie Revenge Dreamcast decompilation
decisions.reason: Region-pinned extraction, assembly rebuild and per-function C equivalence/matching workflow. Game-derived source generated locally; matching whole executable with ASM fallback is not complete C recovery. Test equivalence is scoped to supplied cases and excludes selected SR flags.

decisions.title: Vib-Ribbon PAL decompilation
decisions.reason: Partial C reconstruction of originally C++ game modules. Sample mixes actual C, NON_MATCHING alternatives and INCLUDE_ASM; upstream does not guarantee behavioural equivalence of non-matching paths. Own executables required.

decisions.title: Mega Man X4 PlayStation decompilation
decisions.reason: US executable reconstruction with typed engine/gameplay C and original-file extraction requirements. ROM/executable matching and completeness not independently tested.

decisions.title: Aironauts outro executable decompilation
decisions.reason: Explicitly restricted to OUTROE.EXE and early SDK/GPU recovery, not the whole game. Substantive C wrappers coexist with many INCLUDE_ASM stand-ins; SOTN-derived build and SDK lineage acknowledged.

decisions.title: Paper Mario decompilation
decisions.reason: Structured C code including ambient-audio state machine. Upstream targets US, JP, PAL and iQue images; per-region completion and hash reproduction are not independently measured.

decisions.title: Conker’s Bad Fur Day decompilation
decisions.reason: Partial C recovery, compressed code extraction/repacking and matching rebuild targets. Sample preserves unknown fields and a possible fakematch comment; assembly rebuild must not imply complete understanding. Own ROM required.

decisions.title: Space Station Silicon Valley decompilation
decisions.reason: US/EU source with actual C routines. EU assembly support is not equal to US decompilation progress; NON_MATCHING functional paths are distinct from byte-perfect matching. Own ROM required.

decisions.title: Ocarina of Time n64dd module decompilation
decisions.reason: Disk-drive module and libleo routines extracted from Ocarina of Time, including byte-to-LBA conversion. Not a general 64DD game catalogue or a full Ocarina game decompilation; NTSC1.0 base ROM required.

decisions.title: Game Boy Advance BIOS disassembly
decisions.reason: Named ARM BIOS vectors and routines with devkitARM build. README explicitly says incomplete disassembly requires original BIOS bytes; checksum target is not evidence all routines are reconstructed.

decisions.title: Minakuchi Game Boy disassembly collection
decisions.reason: Mega Man I/III/IV/V and Bionic Commando share related code lineage. Keep root collection whole; original ROM slices fill gaps. Mega Man II deliberately excluded because its developer/codebase differs.

decisions.title: Looney Tunes Carrot Crazy disassembly
decisions.reason: Banked listing with named compressed/uncompressed loader and data-format comments. CLAUDE.md presence alone does not establish AI usage; no build or accuracy claim independently verified.

decisions.title: The Jungle Book Game Boy disassembly
decisions.reason: Annotated engine/object access routines plus extraction/modification utilities. Original assets must be extracted; labelled-code progress differs by bank and bit-exact claim remains upstream-only.

decisions.title: Tetris Attack Game Boy disassembly
decisions.reason: mgbdis-generated banked source with some semantic labels and build/gfx structure. Much remains address-labelled; do not confuse generated listing volume with recovered semantics or measured matching.

decisions.title: RetroPIC multi-platform graphics converter
decisions.reason: Platform-aware image conversion and native graphics outputs including Amiga HAM renderers. Neural palette algorithms describe tool functionality, not evidence AI authored the project. Mode accuracy/export coverage not independently tested.

decisions.title: Console Graphics Converter
decisions.reason: PNG-to-console tile data with palette constraints, tile deduplication and binary/ASM/C exports. Palette quantization is imperfect; embedded palettes recommended. Inspected SNES tile/palette implementation.

decisions.title: Franklin ACE 2000 firmware analysis
decisions.reason: EPROM-read reconstruction and firmware comparison scripts. Majority-vote reconstruction explicitly reports unresolved ties. Historical provenance and clean-room originality are author claims, not independently authenticated or legal findings.

decisions.title: Rad van Fortuin DOS format analysis
decisions.reason: Annotated IDA project, VOC extraction and binary format templates. Source script repairs obfuscated audio headers; this is focused data/code analysis, not full game reconstruction.

decisions.title: Tony La Russa Baseball II analysis and mods
decisions.reason: Version1.3 CD analysis, file-format tooling and in-game dynasty patches. Inspected palette/frame decoder; full reverse engineering is a goal, not established completion. Own game files required; local paths in upstream documentation are not portable defaults.

decisions.title: Apple II DeskTop historical copy
decisions.reason: Commit a63eca2a0e2d008ace3704949cf0c604ef2ec8f0 is an ancestor of tracked a2stuff/a2d main: compare reports ahead 5025, behind 0. GitHub fork:false does not establish a distinct project.

decisions.title: SC-3000 BASIC IIIB placeholder
decisions.reason: Repository contains only a 24-byte README title; no disassembly source established.

decisions.title: Game Boy Camera empty repository
decisions.reason: Repository metadata size zero and commits/master returns 409 Git Repository is empty; descriptive title is not implementation evidence.

decisions.title: Dungeons of Daggorath original-source archive
decisions.reason: Historical assembly modules with annotated dungeon generator, parser, renderer and scanned listing. Repository describes original 1982 source; missing-macros file indicates reconstruction support. Provenance/build completeness not independently certified.

decisions.title: Aishima PC-98 resource toolbox
decisions.reason: Despite index-style repository description, self-contained HTML implements disk overlay reading/writing and Shift-JIS handling plus archive/image/script tools. No data uploaded or candidate code executed in this review; format completeness untested.

decisions.title: NECOPN.DRV MIDI-driver reconstruction
decisions.reason: Driver-behaviour reconstruction uses Python control logic and fmgen sound core, not CPU emulation of the whole OS. Built-in instrument bank but external rhythm WAVs needed; optional LFO and high-fidelity claims remain upstream-only.

decisions.title: GEMS Mega Drive research toolkit
decisions.reason: Sequence splitting/combining, instrument conversion and MIDI export source for GEMS sound data. Root toolkit is distinct from original sound driver and signature-only datasets; no equivalence tests run.

decisions.title: MDSDRV Mega Drive sound driver
decisions.reason: Source-available 68000 sequence driver with Z80 PCM playback and SGDK integration. Windows toolchain/Wine requirements explicit; experimental System C2 branch is not promoted as mainline support.

decisions.title: Mega Drive sound-driver signatures
decisions.reason: Binary radare2 signature databases for GEMS/Krisalis detection. Decoded GEMS database has masked start/stop-song patterns; useful analysis data, not driver source or proof of complete automatic identification.

decisions.title: Master System Pro Action Replay disassembly
decisions.reason: Annotated banking, interrupt interception, cheat-state and firmware source. Distinct cartridge firmware, not a game port; upstream notes timing side effects and unused BIOS/debug material.

decisions.title: Micro Machines Master System analysis and editor
decisions.reason: Named decompressor and broader disassembly alongside incomplete track editor. In-memory editing and compression exist; ROM reinsertion, layout auto-patching and several metadata editors remain unfinished. Keep coherent root project.

decisions.title: Karateka Atari 7800 analysis and patches
decisions.reason: ROM-driven Forth primitive discovery, patch tooling and live-analysis probes. Forth-threaded data is not ordinary linear 6502 code; source toolkit is substantive despite omitted generated game listing. Hardware and patch claims remain upstream-tested only.

decisions.title: Ballblazer Atari 7800 disassembly research
decisions.reason: Machine-readable labels/data boundaries/comments and replay evidence drive locally generated listing from original ROM. Sibling toolkit required; byte-identical reassembly is not complete semantic recovery. README toolkit link is incomplete.

decisions.title: Food Fight Atari 7800 disassembly research
decisions.reason: Reviewed annotation map and research/replay files support regenerated source. Upstream distinguishes limited traced coverage from byte-identical output and notes unresolved data ranges. Requires external toolkit and original ROM.

decisions.title: NES Games Disassembly collection
decisions.reason: Large multi-game source collection generated with BZK scripts and manually labelled. Keep root collection; completed, WIP and planned title lists are distinct. Build and matching claims not independently verified.

decisions.title: NESgen experimental static recompiler
decisions.reason: Academic ROM-to-C translator with NES runtime. Author explicitly limits production-game support; useful recompilation research/tooling, not a general automatic native-port solution.

decisions.title: Daytona USA CCE Saturn reconstruction
decisions.reason: AI-driven reconstruction and physics-transplant research. Sample .c file is a generated naked-assembly shim, not semantic C decompilation. Eight-module matching/relocation tests and transplant goal are upstream claims; own Japanese disc and SaturnAutoRE needed.

decisions.title: Castlevania Symphony of the Night decompilation
decisions.reason: Multi-platform/version reconstruction with actual palette-state C alongside remaining INCLUDE_ASM stubs. Own game assets required; matching builds do not mean equal source completeness across PS1/PSP/Saturn targets.

decisions.title: REDRIVER2 Driver 2 reconstruction
decisions.reason: Symbol-assisted C game reconstruction with actual AI/game logic and Psy-X platform compatibility layer. Upstream notes Memory Card menu exception and gameplay improvements; not a full CPU-emulation wrapper or an untouched byte-matching remake.

decisions.title: Evo’s Space Adventures PSX decompilation
decisions.reason: Proof-of-concept partial C recovery using N64 decomp tools. Explicit cross-project lineage with Space Station Silicon Valley; PSX port differs materially and remains a separate target. Own ESA data required.

decisions.title: xa65 cross-assembler development mirror
decisions.reason: Original author’s experimental mirror and changes to xa65, currently maintained by Cameron Kaiser upstream. Source supports 6502/65816 and object utilities; do not present mirror as sole canonical release source.

decisions.title: Ophis 65xx cross-assembler
decisions.reason: Lexer/parser and assembler for 6502,65C02,4502/4510 and undocumented6510 opcodes. Host portability and supported variants are upstream claims, not independent build results.

decisions.title: xasm Atari 6502 cross-assembler
decisions.reason: D implementation of 6502 assembler with Quick Assembler-derived syntax extensions and default Atari binary output. Distinct from unrelated XASM_LGP30 and xasm65 disassembler projects.

decisions.title: Acorn Communicator BASIC reconstruction
decisions.reason: SourceGen originals plus edited ca65 code for Beeb816/Dossy/Blitter systems. Communicator-target rebuild explicitly untested upstream; labels partly follow 6x09 BASIC and original versus adapted outputs remain distinct.

decisions.title: Acornsoft COMAL disassembly
decisions.reason: Substantive extensionless assembly source with ROM-low, ROM-high and RAM-high configurations for second-processor use. ADE/Lancaster syntax and laxasm build route; no independent build test.

decisions.title: Acorn Communicator MOS disassembly
decisions.reason: Structured SourceGen dis65 projects for OS modules contain CPU selection, symbols and analysis state; menu BASIC and extraction tooling also present. Minimal README does not mean empty implementation; binary modules are not source by themselves.

decisions.title: Helix Apple II bubble-memory firmware
decisions.reason: Partially reversed firmware3.40 with named ProDOS/bubble-controller state and Macro Assembler AS build route. Source evidence exists despite no README; completeness and exact matching unverified.

decisions.title: Rana Elite floppy-controller firmware
decisions.reason: Reverse-engineered controller source for four-drive and13/16-sector boot support. Source author explicitly separates assembly-source copyright from original EPROM ownership; not an official firmware release claim.

decisions.title: cycleSpitter Atari ST scanline tool
decisions.reason: Cycle-table/annotation processing, REPT expansion, scanline splitting and border-code insertion. User annotations can override timings; generated512-cycle accounting is not independent proof of runtime timing for every path.

decisions.title: Atari ST Rust binary-analysis tools
decisions.reason: TOS program-header parser, dumping/analysis crates and m68k decoding components. Sparse documentation; inspected parser establishes actual implementation without claiming full instruction/format coverage.

decisions.title: Atari ST Transputer software collection
decisions.reason: Source programs/tools/demos for ST Transputer interfaces. Inspected Mandelbrot ST server requires T800/T805 FPU; keep special hardware requirement and collection identity rather than implying stock-ST compatibility.

decisions.title: rsrcdump Macintosh resource conversion
decisions.reason: Resource-fork JSON extraction/recreation plus image/audio conversion. PICT support is raster-only; unsupported resources may remain hex/structured data rather than fully decoded assets.

decisions.title: Python Macintosh resource-fork library
decisions.reason: Cross-platform resource reader with standard System7 decompression. Nonstandard resource decompressors unsupported; implementation does not depend on native Mac APIs.

decisions.title: Rezilla Macintosh resource editor
decisions.reason: Historical resource-map editor source with PowerPlant-era document handling, templates and plugin editors. Reads classic resource formats but host is OS X-era; not assumed native68k or compatible with current macOS.

decisions.title: Img2CPC image and tile converter
decisions.reason: Pixel/tile extraction, palette and mask handling for CPC modes0/1/2 with ASM/C outputs. Source implementation reviewed; palette correctness and target rendering not independently tested.

decisions.title: YMCruncher YM-to-AYC converter
decisions.reason: Historical SWT GUI and AYC compression/output code. Author calls code outdated/unreviewed and build depends on system SWT/LHA jars; preserve rather than imply maintained portable packaging.

decisions.title: Tides Rider MSX BIOS development
decisions.reason: Early BIOS source implements Z280 boot/MMU setup and UNAPI support path. Upstream explicitly says many functions missing and nothing tested; substantive code is not a working replacement BIOS claim.

decisions.title: SC-3000 BASIC decoder
decisions.reason: Token-table-based BASIC decoder and encoder modules with pretty/error-handling modes. Genuine implementation distinct from earlier empty BASIC ROM-disassembly placeholder; full round-trip coverage untested.

decisions.title: Alshark PC-98 script tools
decisions.reason: Script extraction/reinsertion code with image offsets and character tables. Research/translation tooling, not full game decompilation or established complete English translation; hardcoded image layout may be version-specific.

decisions.title: Disc Image Studio CPC disk tools
decisions.reason: DSK/AMSDOS/CP-M image tooling with actual header parser and multiple utilities. README retains old clone/path naming; root implementation is under xdsk/xcart/xcdt. No disk images modified or completeness claim independently tested.

decisions.title: Final Fantasy Disch disassembly mirror
decisions.reason: Both this readme.txt and tracked Entroper/FF1Disassembly identify the same Disch v1.0 work with substantially identical author notes. No distinct reconstruction established.

decisions.title: Acorn DFS 2.45 superseded disassembly
decisions.reason: README explicitly calls repository redundant and directs to tracked acorn_1770_dfs_disassembly covering 2.24/2.25/2.26/2.29/2.45.

decisions.title: Caves of Oberon map research
decisions.reason: Detailed technical map write-up and images, but no reconstruction script or machine-readable map artifact found. Article repeats the same offset/range for distinct cell-block and block-grid sections and prints 8292 pixels for 1024 eight-pixel cells. Retain research lead pending reproducible extraction evidence, not a full game reconstruction.

decisions.title: PowerRomDasm Power Macintosh ROM analysis
decisions.reason: Multi-architecture ROM inspection combines 68k, PowerPC and FCode knowledge. Inspected Capstone 68040 decoder and symbol handling; ROM architecture is not inferred solely from the host-machine name.

decisions.title: DSP3210 assembler, disassembler and emulator
decisions.reason: Portable DSP3210 toolchain for AV Macs and unreleased Amiga prototypes, not stock Amiga hardware. Explicit AI-assisted authorship; approximate and exact DAU backends differ. External Sail comparison is optional, not part of default tests.

decisions.title: msxdisa MSX disassembler
decisions.reason: Bank-aware analyzer and ZMA-style output with BIOS symbols. Mapper placement is heuristic, IX/IY coverage partial and runtime mapper writes not emulated; embedded data may be decoded as code.

decisions.title: follow9 6x09 disassembler
decisions.reason: Browser control-flow-following disassembler derived from dasm09. Source and tests present; code/data separation is a technique, not a guarantee every indirect target is recovered.

decisions.title: Disasm09 historical 6809 disassembler
decisions.reason: Preserved 1991 C disassembler. Source prominently records a long-branch handling bug; catalogue as historical tooling rather than an unqualified accurate decoder.

decisions.title: X680x0 miscellaneous system tools
decisions.reason: Human68k drive/buffer/stack inspection and XDF/HDF utilities. Sample has packed drive-state structures. Keep coherent root collection; individual tools have different native/host execution requirements.

decisions.title: 9SCDRV version inspection tool
decisions.reason: Small diagnostic for resident 9SCDRV using _X_KPCHK.O. Upstream warns false detections and out-of-bounds reads can cause bus errors. UTF-8 source requires Shift-JIS conversion for native build; not run here.

decisions.title: MAG MIXER X68000 source
decisions.reason: Preserved 16-colour MAG overlay program using selected transparent colours and palettes. Delegates image decoding/display to external viewer; not a standalone MAG codec.

decisions.title: 68kArray assembly-data formatter
decisions.reason: Delphi/VCL formatter and binary import/export for 68000 arrays. Explicit successor to 68kQuickData; do not count the replaced tool as another current implementation.

decisions.title: ASMUnsplitter assembly-source merger
decisions.reason: Console source expands multipart assembler input to an unsplit output. String-based include processing tailored to Mega Drive workflows; not a general assembler parser or proven semantic refactoring tool.

decisions.title: Pebble Beach Golf Links Mega Drive disassembly
decisions.reason: Europe ROM reconstruction with named 68000/Z80 source and editable asset pipelines. README specifies 870 assembly functions and one C function; 100% physical replacement is not complete semantic understanding. Own ROM required.

decisions.title: Genesis disassembly kickoff toolkit
decisions.reason: Agent-oriented workflow includes actual trace-to-symbolic-assembly generator and analysis scripts. All game-derived output generated locally; semantic progress distinguished from merely decoded bytes. Not a game decompilation itself.

decisions.title: SMB Vanilla C reconstruction
decisions.reason: Actual C gameplay for SMB and Lost Levels with external ROM assets. Missing Lost Levels ending audio and regression tests remain explicit. README denies AI-generated code/assets and directs contributions to Codeberg; that narrower claim is not proof no AI was used for anything.

decisions.title: BioHazard NES disassembly
decisions.reason: Readable bank-switching assembly and IDA analysis. README calls it decompilation, but inspected deliverable is assembly; MMC3 conversion and further recovery remain TODO.

decisions.title: tools7800 development converters
decisions.reason: YAML sprites and TMX tiles become cc7800-specific C data, with MARIA layout keywords. Fat-pixel and sprite-height constraints explicit; output is not portable ordinary C for all compilers.

decisions.title: Atari 7800 cartridge analysis toolkit
decisions.reason: General cartridge/disassembly/graphics/audio and authoring tools used by separately tracked game analyses. Bank-layout exceptions and scope are explicit; upstream corpus coverage not independently reproduced.

decisions.title: sound2tia audio converter
decisions.reason: FFT-driven audio-to-TIA register conversion with batari Basic/assembly outputs. Intended for simpler tones; short windows limit frequency precision and voices/complex songs are poor fits.

decisions.title: PCSX-Redux reverse-engineering environment
decisions.reason: General PS1 emulator/debugger and development tooling derived from PCSX. Inspected debugger implementation; classify as reusable tooling, not a game-specific emulation port.

decisions.title: King’s Field reverse-engineering tools
decisions.reason: Qt tools for map/database/executable/asset inspection. KF2 is main target; other FromSoftware games largely have model/texture loading only. KF3 names may be wrong or objects absent; editing completeness not implied.

decisions.title: Dreamcast Ghidra analysis helper
decisions.reason: Defines MMIO, marks selected read-only references and applies CRC/length SDK signatures. Short functions intentionally skipped due to ambiguity; best-effort naming is not proof of unique identity.

decisions.title: El Dorado Gate Dreamcast text research
decisions.reason: Glyph-table extraction and menu patch/research tools with recorded runtime addresses and tile layouts. Focused text/font work, not a complete game decompilation or translation.

decisions.title: Dragon’s Dream revival-server research
decisions.reason: Actual protocol-server code and analysis scripts exist. Author explicitly says Claude Code wrote the project and warns documentation may be hallucinated; login progress is not verified full online restoration or complete decompilation.

decisions.title: Un-GameBoy interactive analysis
decisions.reason: Bank-aware interactive disassembly project with labels, graphics and analysis state. Early software warns saved work may be lost and exit does not auto-save; no stability guarantee.

decisions.title: GBA library-function signatures
decisions.reason: Text patterns plus FLIRT/YARA/radare signatures for dated library revisions. Sample identifies BIOS-call wrappers. Signature matches are version-bound heuristics, not full source reconstruction.

decisions.title: Slime Mori Mori compression analysis
decisions.reason: Implemented Huffman/displacement/LZ-style decoder modes for custom game compression. Narrow data-format reconstruction, not entire game code.

decisions.title: Shining Force ROTDD research tools
decisions.reason: Text-table and character-edit helpers with documented offset evidence. Broad EOF repointing and multiline rewriting remain experimental/unstable; no claim all ROM patches are safe or compatible.

decisions.title: P65Pas 6502 compiler and IDE
decisions.reason: Simplified Pascal-to-6502 compiler with IDE/debugger and direct PRG output. Basic type/language subset only; inherited PIC-named identifiers do not establish a PIC target.

decisions.title: IceBro 6502 debugger
decisions.reason: CPU simulator/debugger connected to VICE snapshots. Most debugging modifies copied state, history begins at pause and other hardware is not simulated locally; not equivalent to live whole-machine reverse execution.

decisions.title: SGS-68K historical toolchain archive
decisions.reason: Historical C/FORTRAN/RATFOR/EFL and analysis-tool sources. Sample retains AT&T/ARIX proprietary notices; public availability does not establish unrestricted redistribution rights or a modern supported toolchain.

decisions.title: crossmint Atari cross-toolchain builds
decisions.reason: Build scripts/patches for m68k-atari-mint and mintelf GCC/binutils variants. Script explicitly selects target and version; this is packaging/build tooling, not an independent compiler implementation.

decisions.title: zasm Z80-family assembler
decisions.reason: 8080/Z80/Z180/Z80N assembler with syntax conversion, tape outputs, optional SDCC and generated-code tests. Decoder/parser bodies reviewed; target-mode differences and external compiler requirements retained.

decisions.title: MDL Z80 assembly optimizer
decisions.reason: Multi-dialect assembly optimizer, data analysis and profiling tooling. Automated transformations require the correct dialect/semantic assumptions; no universal safe speedup or independent performance result claimed.

decisions.title: zmac macro cross-assembler
decisions.reason: Preserved macro assembler lineage documented back to Bruce Norskog and Ken Borgendale. Yacc implementation includes long modification history; repository is an implementation distribution, not sole original authorship.

decisions.title: Acorn 6502 Tube ROM original sources
decisions.reason: Historical MASM1.20 and UADE1.10 source. README clarifies1.20 internal co-processors exist despite stale description saying unreleased; UADE source not buildable in this distribution. Build needs Turbo256K environment.

decisions.title: Turbo Modula-2 Reloaded
decisions.reason: Re-engineered compiler/editor/system from Turbo Modula-2 with C MCode virtual machine and FAT32/UTF-8 additions. VM portability is explicit; not native machine-code recompilation or unchanged CP/M binary.

decisions.title: 68kQuickData predecessor
decisions.reason: README explicitly says replaced by 68kArray. Successor separately screened and inspected in this batch.

decisions.title: Mega Drive Game Genie placeholder
decisions.reason: Only README and ROM binary present at reviewed commit; no assembly listing or analysis implementation established.

decisions.title: PETSCII Robots CPC-named source
decisions.reason: README identifies ZX Spectrum 48K builds and main.asm declares device zxspectrum48 and savesna main.sna. Substantive game source exists, but advertised CPC adaptation or distinct lineage is not established. Do not assign CPC solely from repository name.

decisions.title: Alternate sjasmplus repository
decisions.reason: Canonical sjasmplus tool already tracked under z00m128/sjasmplus. This alternate repository has implementation, but distinct maintained divergence has not been established. Cross-repository commit comparison returned 404, which is inconclusive rather than proof of independence.

decisions.title: Macintosh Portable ROM reconstruction
decisions.reason: ROM initialization source and power-manager material with ROMTools dependency and assembler optimization controls. Sparse documentation; partial reconstruction and build prerequisites must not imply independently verified complete ROM matching.

decisions.title: Apple Pascal 1.3 system reconstruction
decisions.reason: Pascal/compiler/editor/system sources rebuilt through original tools. Upstream accounts separately for matching file bytes, copied PASCALIO segment, linker slack and disk-image differences; no blanket 100% reconstruction claim.

decisions.title: Acorn CMOS BASIC original source
decisions.reason: Historical version4 MASM source explicitly selects CMOS6502; source/platform version nuances retained. Native build uses6502 co-processor and disk tooling; checksum is upstream claim, not independently reproduced.

decisions.title: Acorn OS 1.20 original source
decisions.reason: Original source archive plus build-fixed working sources. Original line endings, comment error and build bugs documented separately; Turbo256K co-processor environment required by supplied workflow.

decisions.title: Acorn DNFS 3.00 original source
decisions.reason: DFS1.20,NFS3.60 and Tube Host1.10 source package. Upstream explicitly reports two padding-byte differences from released ROM, so a successful source build is not automatically the retail hash.

decisions.title: Acorn MASM 1.15 original source
decisions.reason: Historical macro assembler with normal/Turbo co-processor variants. Supplied workflow uses Turbo256K; unpadded Turbo output may have varying hashes and DFS versions are not currently built.

decisions.title: BBC Domesday Archimedes source archive
decisions.reason: Historical Logica A500 source is an Archimedes adaptation of BBC AIV, not simply the BBC release. Real BCPL lives under build/src/*.b; path rewriting restores build layout, and README notes RISC OS3 linking failure.

decisions.title: Acorn Atom BASIC source and BBC adaptation
decisions.reason: Assembly source distinguishes original Atom ROM and BBC sideways-ROM branch with different OS entry points/workspace. No README; actual conditional source and Makefile establish dual target rather than inference from name.

decisions.title: Saboteur Spectrum standalone assembly
decisions.reason: Single-file annotated source with title-image decoder and ZX-M8XXX entry hints. Related SkoolKit presentation is already tracked and linked upstream; retain that relationship, not a claim of wholly independent reversing.

decisions.title: Taipan Apple II source analysis
decisions.reason: Despite TRS80 repository name, README explicitly says original TRS80 version is not yet present. Actual Apple II BASIC with keyboard PEEK/POKE and machine-code analysis plus mods; no TRS80 target claim.

decisions.title: Genie IIIs Holte CP/M source
decisions.reason: Historical disk/driver/system sources and revision snapshots. TCS Genie IIIs is distinct from EACA Genie III; preserved source/disk images require external emulator or hardware and are not themselves an emulator.

decisions.title: Oberheim Matrix-1000 firmware research
decisions.reason: Address-backed firmware documentation and executable factory-patch decoder. Firmware/patch ROMs are separate; decoder combines byte parameters with external patchbook names. Do not confuse6809 with8031 or claim complete rewrite.

decisions.title: CP/M for Sega SG-1000 and SC-3000
decisions.reason: Proof-of-concept banked cartridge with writable first bank and CBIOS/terminal code. Disk access is read-only and requires compatible/modified emulator mapper; not an ordinary unmodified cartridge or hardware-verified port.

decisions.title: SC-3000 and SF-7000 data tools
decisions.reason: Rust crates for character sets,BASIC and SF7000 filesystem access plus dump command. Source modules establish actual data handling despite absent root README; no complete media compatibility measurement.

decisions.title: Yie Ar Kung-Fu MSX disassembly
decisions.reason: Address-anchored notes, dispatch entries, generated listing and original-ROM checks. Easy/hard dumps compared separately; physical byte coverage and comment density are not identical semantic-certainty measures. Own ROM required.

decisions.title: Double-Duty DOS disassembly
decisions.reason: ProDOS BASIC.SYSTEM extension for DOS3.3 interoperability with named source. Documented whole-sector loads and overwritten bytes are retained hazards, not silently described as safe file operations.

decisions.title: Pool of Radiance DOS analysis workbench
decisions.reason: Resident/overlay listings and extraction/cross-reference tooling behind separate por-go port. No original bytes distributed; scripts use explicit overlay map. Workbench is not the native Go engine itself.

decisions.title: Aerobiz Supersonic Genesis disassembly
decisions.reason: Named68000 module source, ROM/RAM maps and byte-comparison workflow. Repository description says static recompilation but delivered goal/source is assembly reassembly. Complete naming and semantic-quality claims not independently audited.

decisions.title: Sonic 1 Game Gear split disassembly
decisions.reason: Partially split object/music/level source with genuine Jaws enemy logic and substantial remaining binary chunks. Claimed matching build does not mean complete source recovery; overflows can break build.

decisions.title: NGPalTool Neo Geo palette editor
decisions.reason: Palette conversion/editor with explicit5-bit RGB and dark-bit representation plus palette/export formats. Small source-backed tool, not broad graphics conversion or verified hardware colour matching.

decisions.title: Samurai Shodown RPG translation tools
decisions.reason: Table-driven text-to-hex and single/double-byte relative-search utilities. Supports translation investigation; not a complete translation patch or game reconstruction.

decisions.title: sromcrom Neo Geo graphics pipeline
decisions.reason: CROM/SROM tile conversion and integration-code generation with palette/deduplication/layout rules. README credits city41 upstream, now unavailable in this check; preserved implementation does not imply this mirror is canonical maintainer.

decisions.title: Milon’s Secret Castle NES disassembly
decisions.reason: Annotated game routines, tile/string names and Mesen tooling. Large source inspected from pinned read-only Git checkout after connector returned empty content. US matching/completeness claims remain upstream-only.

decisions.title: NES Tetris disassembly tools
decisions.reason: Actual ROM disassembler and hint parser hardcode Tetris cartridge assumptions and memory layout. Early focused analysis tool, not a general NES disassembler or complete Tetris reconstruction.

decisions.title: Shuriken Dreamcast asset explorer
decisions.reason: Browser-local disc/model/texture/code exploration augmented by game decomp maps. ADX decoder explicitly excludes AHX; raw-disc features and decomp-assisted assembled animation differ. No game assets supplied.

decisions.title: Boku Doraemon Dreamcast decompilation
decisions.reason: Version-pinned disc extraction,assembly reconstruction and function-equivalence pipeline. All game-derived code generated locally; whole executable matching with assembly baseline is not complete C recovery. Requires original disc and Katana tools.

decisions.title: mgbdis Game Boy ROM disassembler
decisions.reason: RGBDS-compatible banked output with symbol-defined code/data/image blocks. Without boundaries can misidentify instruction alignment; runtime-derived symbol input helps but cannot prove all code paths.

decisions.title: Windfish Game Boy tracing disassembler
decisions.reason: SameBoy-integrated tracing/region/type-aware assembly generation and UI. Originated around Link’s Awakening but is now general-purpose tooling; inferred scope/bank knowledge not universal static certainty.

decisions.title: GameRoy emulator and debugger
decisions.reason: Debugger with runtime/static tracing, breakpoints and reverse stepping. Explicit DMG-only support; do not assign GBC capability from generic Game Boy naming. Accuracy claims not independently tested.

decisions.title: RetroIO filesystem and protocol libraries
decisions.reason: Reusable storage/network packages with actual Commodore image factory and filesystem implementations. Explicit Claude-assisted code disclosure; broad package list is not uniform independently verified format coverage.

decisions.title: C02 6502 C-syntax compiler
decisions.reason: Expression/parser code produces DASM assembly for a deliberately modified C subset. Not a standards-complete C compiler; platform scripts may need path fixes.

decisions.title: Atalan retargetable 8-bit compiler
decisions.reason: Preserved/updated rule-driven compiler with actual basic-block optimization. Original author Rudla/Rudolf Kudla credited; abandoned origins, bugs and documentation drift explicit, not a polished maintained compiler claim.

decisions.title: LZSA compression and 8-bit decoders
decisions.reason: Byte-aligned formats,host compressor and architecture-specific decoders. Raw/stream and forward/backward variants require correct pairing; performance comparisons remain upstream workload-specific.

decisions.title: Daniel Dallmann opt65 peephole optimizer
decisions.reason: Historical optimizer v0.12 with Ralph Moeritz modifications. Original freeware/non-sale notice retained; not automatically unrestricted open-source licensing or proven semantic safety.

decisions.title: reasm Motorola 68000 assembler
decisions.reason: reasm-core-based assembler with concrete ADD/SUB addressing-form implementation. Dependency and supported instruction-family boundaries remain explicit; no build or complete-ISA claim tested.

decisions.title: Easier68k assembler and simulator
decisions.reason: Archived student-origin project with actual opcode assembly/execution code. Incomplete ISA/floating-point and accurate cycle measurement remain missing; not an accurate full-machine emulator.

decisions.title: ResKnife Macintosh resource editor
decisions.reason: Historical Classic/Carbon and separate Cocoa implementations. README describes incomplete pre-release editor and recommends copies of files; source availability does not establish current macOS compatibility or safe editing.

decisions.title: extract-adf Amiga OFS recovery
decisions.reason: Recovers files from broken OFS ADF/ADZ/DMS media with timestamps. FFS unsupported; invalid end-sector can trigger bus error. Read-only code review, no user disks accessed.

decisions.title: Rust PFS3 filesystem tools
decisions.reason: PFS3 rootblock/anode parser plus read/write/check/FUSE tools for images and devices. Host filesystem implementation distinct from original Amiga driver; write/repair safety not independently tested or exercised.

decisions.title: The Hobbit SC-3000 empty repository
decisions.reason: Description advertises an AI SC-3000 port, but repository metadata has size 0 and commits/main returns 409 Git Repository is empty. Preserve as lead, not an implemented port.

decisions.title: bbc-c virtual-machine compiler suite
decisions.reason: C compiler targets a custom VM running on6502. Its -6502 option assembles/links only and cannot compile C natively. Includes actual optimizer,assembler/linker and media tools; VM target must not be labelled x86 hardware.

decisions.title: FROTH BBC compiler type-in restoration
decisions.reason: Corrected rekeying of Jeremy Ruston’s1983 threaded-language compiler. Hybrid FROTH is not full Forth; inline6502 assembly prevents running unchanged under modern BBC BASIC Windows/SDL.

decisions.title: Pascal for Human Beings restoration
decisions.reason: Rekeyed1982 compiler translates a small Pascal subset into printed BBC BASIC, not native CPU code. No procedures,arrays,sets,file I/O or robust syntax checking; output capture required.

decisions.title: Atari ST disk conversion and deduplication tools
decisions.reason: ST/MSA image loading/conversion and deduplication implementation. Personal toolset with format-size validation; not all preservation formats or copy-protected media supported by inference.

decisions.title: ManifeST Atari ST disk cataloguer
decisions.reason: Qt/SQLite catalogue with disk-engine integration,hashes and heuristic title/signature detection. Incremental path/mtime/size skipping differs from deep content hashes; early-development speed and accuracy claims not independently tested.

decisions.title: OpcodeOracle 6502 analysis environment
decisions.reason: Implemented control-flow/region analysis plus MCP and AI-client integration. AI-assisted analysis is a tool feature, not by itself proof AI authored the code. Entry points and heuristic classification still need review.

decisions.title: dax64 C64 assembly tools
decisions.reason: Assembler/disassembler and BASIC DATA extraction/loaders with VICE execution support. README explicitly excludes data areas in machine code and macro-style directives; not comprehensive round-trip analysis.

decisions.title: 6800/6809 assembler and emulator
decisions.reason: Alpha assembler,CPU library and limited FLEX environment built through template processing. Interrupts unsupported and correctness not verified upstream; target directives and output formats are limited.

decisions.title: MSXBAS2ROM BASIC compiler
decisions.reason: MSX BASIC-to-ROM compiler with concrete resource-management implementation and platform packages. Supported statements/features require reference guide; no independent build/performance test. Agent config/funding appeal not treated as authorship proof.

decisions.title: ZX Spectrum ROM SjASMPlus source
decisions.reason: Single-file16K ROM assembly with historical Logan/O’Hara labels and contributor attribution. Alternate assembler-ready presentation alongside tracked SkoolKit ROM; not new original authorship or unrestricted ROM rights.

decisions.title: Source Solutions Spectrum ROM reconstruction
decisions.reason: Static multi-file recreated ROM source using RASM/Pasmo syntax. Historical reference rather than actively evolving firmware; source-document licence and original binary rights distinguished as upstream states.

decisions.title: Human68k source-code generator
decisions.reason: Maintained disassembler/flow analysis descended from K.Abe/R.ShimiZu code. Native build requires UTF-8-to-Shift-JIS conversion; text encoding is a real build dependency, not cosmetic metadata.

decisions.title: Hopper X68000 executable loader
decisions.reason: Parses Human68k X-file headers and can mark DOS calls. Requires Hopper SDK and separate m68k CPU plugin; loader alone is not a standalone disassembler.

decisions.title: Art of Fighting Neo Geo source archive
decisions.reason: Historical object/action source preserved from accidentally included mastering material according to archive README. Not an official open-source release; copyright/provenance and period MRI/DOS toolchain caveats retained.

decisions.title: HuSIC PC Engine sound tools
decisions.reason: MML compiler and sound/runtime tooling with actual data-generation source. General music development system, not a game-specific emulator or proof of all advertised playback behaviours.

decisions.title: Ghidra SNES loader and analyzer
decisions.reason: Ghidra ROM loader/header/analyzer/exporter implementation despite terse README. Ghidra extension compatibility and complete mapper coverage not independently verified; CLAUDE.md alone not AI-use proof.

decisions.title: PSX Doom GEC reconstruction
decisions.reason: Address-commented enemy logic and platform source. Requires original SLUS-00077 files and Psy-Q; disc LBA tables need regeneration after layout changes. Related to but distinct from PsyDoom native port.

decisions.title: PSX Final Doom GEC reconstruction
decisions.reason: Final Doom-specific continuation of GEC Doom reconstruction,including mouse support. Own SLUS-00331 data and period SDK required; shared routines do not erase distinct target/version identity.

decisions.title: Crash Bash PSX decompilation
decisions.reason: Partial minigame C including bot adjacency logic,loaded alongside original through modding toolchain/PCSX-Redux8MB mode. Identified-function counts differ from decompiled functions; not complete standalone game.

decisions.title: Harry Potter PSX decompilation
decisions.reason: Actual strategy/interpreter C and injected-hook workflow. Incremental replacement alongside original game with expanded-memory tooling; not full native port or completed matching build.

decisions.title: Azure Dreams PSX modding research
decisions.reason: Shop patcher and separate unfinished second-town work with sector EDC/ECC repair. Modifies disc images; source was read only here. Finished shop features do not establish completion of town expansion or full decompilation.

decisions.title: DIS68K historical disassembler
decisions.reason: Preserved1993-era C decoder with later68030 additions and reassemblable output mode. Historical conio/runtime assumptions remain; not complete modern ISA or portability guarantee.

decisions.title: clown68000 CPU and disassembler library
decisions.reason: ANSI C interpreter/disassembler library. Author explicitly prioritizes performance over cycle accuracy; CPU support is not whole-system emulation.

decisions.title: Acorn OnliBasic extension disassembly
decisions.reason: Variant-specific listings and analysis scripts for System/Atom/TOSDOS contexts with named clock/port state. Not a single identical ROM across all variants; no independent rebuild performed.

decisions.title: Black Acorn Atom sign ROM disassembly
decisions.reason: ES5700 Pearce sign-system ROM with named cursor/buffer/VIA state and disassembly driver. Special-purpose Black Atom firmware,not generic Atom BASIC or OS.

decisions.title: Apple Pascal p-code disassembler
decisions.reason: Proof-of-concept codefile/segment reader and p-code instruction/jump-table decoder. Targets virtual-machine code,not native6502 instructions; malformed-file robustness untested.

decisions.title: libres Macintosh resource library
decisions.reason: C resource-fork reader with public/internal API source. File-format library rather than resource GUI or complete all-resource semantic decoder.

decisions.title: KSFL structured binary-format library
decisions.reason: Mac/Palm/PE/DFF/chunk-format APIs and CLI. Implemented Java MacResourceFile reviewed; other-language support is planned,not shipped by inference.

decisions.title: Macintosh resource Kaitai specifications
decisions.reason: Concrete WIND/BNDL/version/template format schemas with offsets and documentation. Core resource-fork/compression schemas moved to official Kaitai repo; this repository retains individual resource formats.

decisions.title: Resplendence resource editor
decisions.reason: Substantive Java Finder/resource editor rewrite. Author calls it unfinished; KSFL,PowerPaint and OpenXION are separate build dependencies,not bundled capabilities assumed present.

decisions.title: Exhume matching-decompilation toolkit
decisions.reason: Actual per-function masked matching and original-toolchain runners plus agent workflows. Extracted from tracked Underworld Exhumed but separately reusable; masked fixup matches differ from final whole-file byte equality.

decisions.title: RAD DOS preservation reconstruction
decisions.reason: Typed segmented C recovered from assembly/Reko with hardware/DOS boundary replacements. Actual functions and register/output modelling inspected; whole-game fidelity and completion not independently demonstrated.

decisions.title: TRS-80 TypeScript tool suite
decisions.reason: Coherent monorepo of Z80 assembler/disassembler/emulator,media libraries and IDE. BASIC decoder distinguishes tape/disk headers; ModelI/III support and other model work must not be conflated.

decisions.title: bas2uef BBC BASIC tape packager
decisions.reason: Tokenizes BBC BASIC2 source and packages cassette blocks into UEF. Specific BASIC dialect/media conversion,not a general BASIC compiler or universal tape encoder.

decisions.title: Acorn BBC BASIC 128 source restoration
decisions.reason: Original1.11 source plus missing/broken Bas10 reconstructed from disassembly and translated back to MASM. Keep original archive and repaired build source distinction; co-processor build not run here.

decisions.title: Madou Monogatari I PC Engine translation
decisions.reason: Translation source/assets/scripts and disc preparation tools. Requires matching original mixed-mode ISO/WAV/CUE image and dependencies; tools source does not include authorization to redistribute original game assets.

decisions.title: Galaxy Fraulein Yuna translation source
decisions.reason: Translation build,script spreadsheet and adventure-string overlay tools for original HCD2031 release. Specific disc track layout and ODS-to-CSV step retained; not all Yuna editions supported by inference.

decisions.title: TurboRip PC Engine disc ripper
decisions.reason: Win32 mixed-mode disc extraction/CUE generation with track-gap rules. Requires physical-drive/platform support; broad Windows/drive-perfect claims not independently tested and no disc accessed.

decisions.title: amiga-cc cross-toolchain setup
decisions.reason: Installer/build example for vbcc,vasm and vlink. Fetches vendor archives and edits shell environment via helper; no installation performed here and not an independent compiler.

decisions.title: libnix 3 Amiga C runtime source
decisions.reason: Updated standard C link-library sources from earlier libnix lineage with file/socket/timer fixes. Only changed nix component included,not a complete GCC SDK or all supporting libraries.

decisions.title: tb.lib Amiga AISS image library
decisions.reason: AISS logical-name artwork loading and BOOPSI/GadTools UI objects with per-process cache. Requires TBIMAGES assign,AISS assets and datatype stack; not a standalone PNG decoder or bundled artwork set.

decisions.title: ga.lib empty repository
decisions.reason: Repository commit lookup returns 409 Git Repository is empty. No implementation can be inspected; defer rather than infer from toolkit association.

decisions.title: Konami Game Master 2 disassembly
decisions.reason: Commented 16-bank RC-755 cheat-cartridge disassembly with SRAM, game hooks and built-in Tennis/Hockey. Upstream claims full byte coverage and render/music checks; original ROM required and no verification rerun here.

decisions.title: Parsec DOS executable unpacker
decisions.reason: Unpacks an obscure DOS executable packer using Unicorn x86 execution, DOS EXE relocation handling and an instruction ceiling. This is binary-analysis tooling, not a reconstructed game or emulator-based game port.

decisions.title: Game Boy hardware research tools
decisions.reason: Concrete FPGA clock/LCD experiments, test ROMs, dumpers and detailed PPU timing observations. Hardware-assisted research suite rather than a complete Game Boy emulator; measurement setup and assumptions remain explicit.

decisions.title: Maniac Mansion EXEPACK unpacker
decisions.reason: Kotlin implementation for a specific enhanced EGA MANIAC.EXE hash. Author later identified Microsoft EXEPACK; not a general game reconstruction and output only claimed close to original unpacked executable.

decisions.title: exhal and inhal HAL compression tools
decisions.reason: HAL format decompression and recompression/insertion for selected NES, SNES and Game Boy titles. Format has a 64 KiB input ceiling with tighter practical limits; multi-platform data format does not imply one CPU.

decisions.title: NABU CP/M 3 disk compatibility patcher
decisions.reason: Moves NABU out-of-band disk parameter data into the boot sector and patches CPMLDR/CPM3.SYS fallback reads. Recognised image geometries and overwrite checks are explicit; writes a separate patched image, not a generic CP/M converter.

decisions.title: Pocket Bomberman memory analysis
decisions.reason: Small concrete WRAM map covering bombs, lives, timer and candidate camera/flag fields. Partial binary-analysis notes only; uncertain entries remain marked and there is no disassembly, build or recovered implementation.

decisions.title: Vortex F1-X CP/M disk tool
decisions.reason: Lists and extracts files from raw 720 KB Vortex VDOS images, not CPC emulator DSK containers or arbitrary CP/M disks. CP/M record lengths cannot establish exact original file sizes; text-tail cleanup must not be applied to binaries.

decisions.title: FTPMount Amiga handler backport
decisions.reason: Work-in-progress backport of AmigaOS4 FTP filesystem fixes to OS3/68k. Source depends on Roadshow SDK, NDK and remaining installation package; no general claim of a finished or securely modernised FTP client.

decisions.title: AMOS bank extractor
decisions.reason: Extracts AMOS icons/sprites and Pac.Pic images, samples and selected memory banks. HAM becomes RGB PNG while other images preserve indexed palette; external palette option and mono 8-bit sample assumption matter. AMAL handling remains planned.

decisions.title: TetraPack Amiga unpacker
decisions.reason: C implementation of TetraPack unpacking with explicit source register-style state and Hunk support. Historical packer archives are reference inputs; no candidate executable or sample was run.

decisions.title: Iskra Delta Partner CP/M disk tools
decisions.reason: Reusable CP/M backend and CLI for Partner G/P floppy and hard-disk geometries, extraction, extent repair and boot tracks. Modern C++23 tool; geometry names and logical tracks must not be confused with physical cylinders.

decisions.title: ResKnife Xcode 4.1 modernization branch
decisions.reason: Divergent continuation of tracked nickshanks/ResKnife: local commit graph shows 9 unique commits versus 13 on tracked branch. Changes include Xcode 4.1 project modernization and plugin dependencies. NuTemplateEditor includes duplicated historical code, not a newly invented editor; no current macOS compatibility claim.

decisions.title: Arkos Tracker Atari ST replay
decisions.reason: 68000 adaptation of Arkos 2/3 replay with source Z80 material, optional SID voices and alternative speed/size paths. ST PSG clock/export settings required; upstream scanline timings not independently benchmarked.

decisions.title: NoExtra Atari ST source archive
decisions.reason: Coherent archive of NoExtra intros/demos and associated assets, retained as one root project. Sample has Devpac requirements, VBL/raster/starfield code and credited music/graphics; no blanket rights or portable-build claim.

decisions.title: rsrce resource-fork editor
decisions.reason: Unix command-line raw resource-fork editor originally for miBoot configuration. Import/export and external-editor round trips are implemented, but upstream warns of limited testing and unusable-output risk.

decisions.title: ResourceForkReader .NET library
decisions.reason: Modern .NET parsing of classic resource headers, maps and typed records with stream extraction and bounds checks. Host-side library, not Macintosh executable reconstruction or a resource editor.

decisions.title: WimpLib RISC OS BASIC library
decisions.reason: Plain-text BASIC Wimp routines build to tokenised BASIC or BASICTxt using GCCSDK and external author tools. SYS calls do not make this native ARM machine-code source; runtime minima not independently established.

decisions.title: RISC OS file-format JavaScript library
decisions.reason: Parses Draw, Font Outlines and Sprite files with SVG/PNG conversion scripts and checked structured readers. Modern host library; supported file formats do not establish an ARM execution requirement.

decisions.title: CPC tape audio to CDT converter
decisions.reason: Browser AudioWorklet pulse processing and CDT writer for standard CPC 464 blocks from WAV or live audio. Standard tape scope only, not all custom loaders; no microphone permission requested or tape uploaded.

decisions.title: Magick2CPC graphics converter
decisions.reason: MagickWand conversion to z88dk/CPCRSlib sprite source with CPC palette/mode tables. Caller supplies correctly sized image, CPC Plus unsupported and CPCRSlib mode 0 is the tested path; empty README must not hide README.md.

decisions.title: AlexLib RISC OS source library
decisions.reason: Historical Toolbox/utility library with concrete gadget wrappers. Author explicitly says file-extension reorganisation was not reflected in Makefile, so build needs repair; includes unfinished experiments and is no longer supported.

decisions.title: tj_dis Jaguar RISC disassembler
decisions.reason: Small C disassembler with Jaguar RISC opcode tables and lyxass-header detection. Must not infer 68000 from Jaguar platform: inspected instruction set targets the custom RISC processors.

decisions.title: siddasm2 SID NSF SAP disassembler
decisions.reason: Music-container-aware 6502 disassembler for SID, NSF and SAP with load/init/play entry data. Successor to Gufino's earlier SID disassembler, not a whole-game decompilation or audio decoder.

decisions.title: bhop NES music driver
decisions.reason: FamiTracker-compatible ca65 music driver with optional expansion-chip paths and banking constraints. Music data and player must be mapped during updates; channel muting integrates external sound effects rather than a complete SFX engine.

decisions.title: FamiTone 5 NES music driver
decisions.reason: Unofficial extension of Shiru's FamiTone2 with effects, full notes, volume columns and conversion tools. Requires its matching converters; fork false does not imply independent origin and it is not the original FamiTone2 project.

decisions.title: MACScnv2 X68000 animation helper
decisions.reason: Generates batch/source processing for MACS animation assets from prepared images/audio. Multi-stage workflow requires external converters, assembler/linker and modified playback stack; helper is not a standalone video decoder.

decisions.title: 86-DOS 0.11 source reconstruction
decisions.reason: Reconstructed SCP 8086 OS and utilities with original cross-assembler syntax and claimed exact binaries. Explicitly not Microsoft's official source release; old non-IBM-PC machine target and provenance are retained.

decisions.title: 86-DOS disk-image reconstruction tools
decisions.reason: Builds complete historical 86-DOS disk layouts using reconstructed source, binaries and preserved filesystem junk. Credits earlier 0.11 reconstruction; distinct image/toolchain work, not a second independent recovery of every program.

decisions.title: CoCo Audio Spectrum Analyzer disassembly
decisions.reason: Commented 1981 Steve Bjork cartridge disassembly with semigraphics, PIA/SAM addresses and kaleidoscope routines. Upstream reports working rebuild; remaining TODO/comment gaps and unverified local build are explicit.

decisions.title: Street Fighter III Third Strike PS2 decompilation
decisions.reason: Actual game AI pattern functions and data source inspected. Upstream says game code fully decompiled while CRI middleware remains partial; full-game claim must not become whole-binary completion or independent build proof.

decisions.title: Crash Team Racing native PC port
decisions.reason: Native SDL3 port based on CTR-ModSDK decompilation, with compiled game overlays and host platform layer. Retains PS1-style memory conventions but no MIPS execution requirement; requires own NTSC-U raw 2352-byte-sector disc image, not cooked ISO.

decisions.title: pvmm/antarctic
decisions.reason: GitHub cross-fork comparison against tracked ricbit/antarctic shows 0 ahead and 6 behind. No unique committed work at reviewed tip; retain tracked upstream rather than add duplicate.

decisions.title: regregex/challenger_disassembly
decisions.reason: GitHub cross-fork comparison against tracked tom-seddon/challenger_disassembly shows 0 ahead and 1 behind. No unique committed work at reviewed tip; retain tracked upstream rather than add duplicate.

decisions.title: mincebert/exmon2_disassembly
decisions.reason: GitHub cross-fork comparison against tracked tom-seddon/exmon2_disassembly shows 0 ahead and 0 behind. No unique committed work at reviewed tip; retain tracked upstream rather than add duplicate.

decisions.title: jaegonlee/boogaboo_disasm_msx
decisions.reason: GitHub cross-fork comparison against tracked mcolom/boogaboo_disasm_msx shows 0 ahead and 0 behind. No unique committed work at reviewed tip; retain tracked upstream rather than add duplicate.

decisions.title: drhelius/gearlynx-vscode
decisions.reason: GitHub cross-fork comparison against tracked ganksoft/gearlynx-vscode shows 0 ahead and 52 behind. No unique committed work at reviewed tip; retain tracked upstream rather than add duplicate.

decisions.title: amigazen/HTTPMount
decisions.reason: Confirmed GitHub 409: repository is empty. No implementation or source to inspect; do not infer FTPMount-like functionality from the name.

decisions.title: gungwald/basic-compiler
decisions.reason: Source compile() only loops through bytes and prints them; assembly output stream is never used for emission. cc65 build scaffolding is not an implemented Applesoft compiler. Revisit when parsing/code generation exists.

decisions.title: mourix/MV-LED
decisions.reason: Concrete Neo Geo credit-counter PCB reproduction with Altium design, scans, BOM and Gerbers, but no firmware/software reconstruction. Retain as hardware-adjacent lead; current software target taxonomy does not represent board-only restoration without mislabelling it.

decisions.title: deater Apple II source and disk tools
decisions.reason: Root repository has grown beyond DOS 3.3 utilities into demos, games, graphics, disk and sound work. Keep one coherent project rather than mechanically split subdirectories; inspected catalog-sector traversal and original author inventory.

decisions.title: ProDOS 8 read-only FUSE filesystem
decisions.reason: Linux FUSE reader for Apple II ProDOS 8 images with block/sector conversion. Author limits scope to personal small-disk recovery, excludes ProDOS 16 and warns of limited robustness. Internal block-write helpers do not establish a writable mounted filesystem.

decisions.title: KabutoCrunch C64 compressor
decisions.reason: C99 compressor and small 6502 decoders with separate proprietary and Dali-compatible bitstream modes. Credits Salvador, ZX0 and TSCrunch lineage; round-trip verification code is present but speed and compression claims were not benchmarked here.

decisions.title: RISC OS Python disassembler
decisions.reason: Capstone-backed ARM, Thumb and AArch64 decoding with RISC OS SWI/function and presentation conventions. Dependency-backed disassembler rather than a new CPU decoder; ARM64 support does not prove classic-machine execution compatibility.

decisions.title: BBC BASIC 4r32 disassembly and maths analysis
decisions.reason: Annotated beebasm disassembly plus C models of logarithm/trigonometric routines and documented six-byte table-index fix. Source enables 65C02 opcodes; math models are analysis aids, not a complete C port of BASIC.

decisions.title: RainBIOS MSX compatibility firmware
decisions.reason: Independent BIOS compatibility subset with source-built BASIC payload, disk drivers and explicit unfinished ABI coverage. Component notice identifies imported R. T. Russell interpreter and ZX0 code; independent BIOS is not wholly original combined firmware and name permissions are separate from source licensing.

decisions.title: PC-98 MAG image tools
decisions.reason: MAKI02 16-colour MAG decode/encode/palette tools extracted from ADV98 work. Requires width divisible by eight, excludes 256-colour MAG, and RGB quantization may alter colours. README explicitly discloses ChatGPT and Codex assistance.

decisions.title: DoSWF Flash unpacker
decisions.reason: Reads FWS headers and DefineBinaryData tags to remove DoSWF packing/obfuscation. DOS in repository name is not MS-DOS: classify as Flash binary-analysis tooling. Narrow format and sparse bounds checks retained; no movie executed.

decisions.title: overlazy DOS overlay analysis
decisions.reason: Analyzes, splits and flattens Microsoft C 5.1 overlay executables with IDA fixup scripts. Other compiler-version support is speculative upstream; mapping above stack and limited bounds checks are explicitly documented.

decisions.title: Master System Evolution menu disassembly
decisions.reason: Emulicious-generated menu disassembly with bank maps and included data segments. This is the console menu, not disassemblies of every bundled game; generic labels and unknown pointer-table indexes remain.

decisions.title: Z80 to TMS9900 assembly translator
decisions.reason: Partial assembly parser/translator with concrete DJNZ lowering and tests. Unsupported forms emit unassemblable comments requiring manual work; automatic MSX hardware remapping and finished game ports remain goals rather than proven outputs.

decisions.title: Emerald Dragon PC Engine translation source
decisions.reason: Translation source, script compression and disc-build tools for Emerald Dragon. Existing dictionaries are cached and need regeneration after edits; CSV text comes from external editor workflow and original disc data is required.

decisions.title: Zero4 Champ PC Engine translation source
decisions.reason: Translation source/art/script with specific font and script builders. CSV is the build input; removed ODS spreadsheet is not missing implementation. Requires original game data and compatible WLA-DX/toolchain dependencies.

decisions.title: Cyber Knight PC Engine translation tools
decisions.reason: Concrete bank extraction, script matching and 512-to-768 KiB ROM expansion. Menus largely translated but main story partial with alignment/control-code issues; SNES English text is a translation reference, not evidence this targets SNES.

decisions.title: IDA 6.x 65816 processor module
decisions.reason: IDA SDK-derived 65816 processor extension with opcode tables and bank tracking. Targets IDA 6.x and expected SDK 6.9; incompatible new API versions must not be presented as current IDA support. Separate SNES loader dependency retained.

decisions.title: IDA 6.x SPC700 processor module
decisions.reason: SPC700 instruction-analysis module, despite README heading calling it a sound-file loader. Requires separate SPC loader and legacy IDA SDK; explicitly incompatible with IDA 7 or later.

decisions.title: 65816disasm flow-analysis disassembler
decisions.reason: Script-controlled LoROM/HiROM analysis follows stack/register state and stops when immediate widths become indeterminate. Limited tested games and bank-boundary caveats; full-byte listing option can produce very large output, not imply complete semantic recovery.

decisions.title: Snestistics trace-guided SNES disassembler
decisions.reason: Uses modified emulator trace sessions and annotations to generate readable assembly, plus conservative prediction. Actual predictor handles unknown P state and data scopes; execution coverage is not whole-ROM proof. Emulator/submodule dependencies retained.

decisions.title: PS1 Argonaut format research and extractors
decisions.reason: Asset/container documentation and extractors for Croc 2 and PS1 Harry Potter 1/2. Unsupported Aladdin, Croc 1, Alien Resurrection and other titles remain excluded; generic Argonaut branding is not universal format compatibility.

decisions.title: vcdextract Saturn disc extractor
decisions.reason: Saturn disc-image extraction with raw-sector, XA and MPEG handling for later rebuilding. Source distinguishes ISO and raw tracks; this is media tooling, not recovery of game code or proof of lossless rebuilt discs.

decisions.title: Saturn SEQ to MIDI converter
decisions.reason: Parses Saturn Sequence 2.00 tempo/gate/event data with accompanying format documentation. MIDI conversion cannot establish original instrument choices; format limitations and history of loop/note-off fixes retained.

decisions.title: Saturn save conversion tools
decisions.reason: Host tools convert BUP, SAROO, XML, B64 and CMS single saves and unpack SGM archives. Format-specific metadata/date conversion inspected; not a full backup-RAM filesystem emulator and no user saves were modified.

decisions.title: Dragon 6809 hardware experiments
decisions.reason: Small concrete character-set, joystick and screen experiments with register conventions, Asm6809 build and XRoar launcher. Root-level development examples, not a restored commercial game or general Dragon compatibility suite.

decisions.title: Colleen Calculator source restoration
decisions.reason: Carol Shaw source printouts shared with permission, imaged and OCR/proofread, preserving separate 8K and 9K versions. Listing and conversion script are actual source evidence, but finished-version identification remains qualified and no fresh assembly performed.

decisions.title: RAMbrandt Atari source archive
decisions.reason: Author-supplied Forth graphics program, Okimate utilities and multiple dated disk/source variants. Two archived images have documented bad sectors; latest source must not imply all historical variants are complete or repaired.

decisions.title: CP/M 2.2 CCP and BDOS source
decisions.reason: Reformatted original CCP/BDOS for Macro Assembler AS. Upstream exactness claim explicitly excludes six-byte serial numbers in each component; not complete machine-specific BIOS or an unconditional byte-exact whole operating system image.

decisions.title: MMS CP/M 3 source suite
decisions.reason: MMS CP/M system, monitor, CP/NET, utilities and related historical software archive. Concrete banked character-I/O code inspected; source/binary mixes and Unix-to-CP/M text conversion requirements preserved at root rather than splitting every directory.

decisions.title: Fusion Forth Atari ST source
decisions.reason: 1985 interpreter/compiler/IDE source with threaded execution, Atari trap calls, editor and libraries. Author licence included; historical source is not independently verified to build with a modern assembler.

decisions.title: mfsreader Macintosh disk extractor
decisions.reason: Simple MFS reader extracts separate DATA and RSRC forks from early Macintosh disk images. Header handling and 400K-era assumptions require care; not HFS support or a general mounted filesystem.

decisions.title: dsk2dc Macintosh disk-image converter
decisions.reason: Wraps raw Macintosh images in Disk Copy 4.2 structure with checksums and optional MacBinary metadata/padding. Container conversion only, not filesystem repair or preservation of unknown flux-level disk features.

decisions.title: mfsutils Macintosh MFS tools
decisions.reason: MFS reader with raw/DC42 detection, fork-preserving MacBinary/BinHex extraction and pseudo-folder navigation. Explicitly rejects HFS; mount command selects a state file rather than mounting a kernel filesystem. Companion image creation is separate.

decisions.title: Acorn SDT 2.11a compiler source
decisions.reason: Historical SDT C/C++ compiler source with ARM/Thumb targets and backend configuration. Original host was Windows 98; repository warns modern builds need engineering. Acorn target must not be confused with host platform.

decisions.title: Atomic AGD script compiler
