decisions.reason: Kees van Oss Atom adaptation of Jonathan Cauldwell AGD. C script vocabulary retains historical Z80-style comments, while supplied engine uses concrete 6502 Atom hardware addresses; target CPU determined from implementation rather than stale comments.

decisions.title: SixtyPical analysed 6502 language
decisions.reason: Low-level language/compiler with dataflow constraints, meaningfulness and range checks before 6502 emission. Repository identifies itself as a Codeberg mirror; preserve upstream identity and do not count mirror as an independent language implementation.

decisions.title: Xenon 2 MSX2 sprite prototype
decisions.reason: Software-sprite/triple-buffer rendering experiment using Xenon 2 assets with mapped sprite pages. Concrete C/Z80 routines, not a full Xenon 2 game reconstruction or completed port. Stored prompt files alone do not establish completed AI authorship.

decisions.title: Microsoft BASIC detokenizer collection
decisions.reason: Preserved Ratliff/Orignac lineage with explicit small STEP-token addition for CP/M M BASIC and Epson laptop variants. Real token/numeric handling across dialects; not a compiler and not all dialect work newly authored by this repository owner.

decisions.title: M.A.X. 2 resource extractor
decisions.reason: RES/CAF/WLD asset extraction with concrete resource-header and image/audio modules. Unknown payloads remain extensionless; recovered assets do not imply native game source or a playable reimplementation.

decisions.title: Amiga MC68060 support package
decisions.reason: Historical Motorola integer/floating-point support plus Amiga 68060.library integration and exception-vector setup. Distinguish vendor core from Amiga callouts; not 68000-compatible library and no system vectors changed or binaries executed here.

decisions.title: STrinkler Atari executable packer
decisions.reason: Atari adaptation of Amiga Shrinkler with PRG/raw modes and verification. Minimal mode trades compatibility for size, larger executables may decrunch slowly; performance claims upstream only and original compression lineage credited.

decisions.title: WebP Amiga picture datatype
decisions.reason: AmigaOS 3.x BOOPSI WebP decoder using external libwebp and picture.datatype v43+. Animated files show first frame only; low-depth remapping is delegated to picture.datatype. StackSwap guard and no-libnix shared-library constraints inspected; not an A500/68000 build.

decisions.title: r2d2rigo/IL2Z80
decisions.reason: Pinned tree has only README, LICENSE and gitignore. No IL parser, emitter or implementation exists to inspect; defer until source is present.

decisions.title: RetroStack/TRS-80-Model-I-System-ROMs
decisions.reason: Repository explicitly contains ROM binary bundles and adapter guidance, not source/disassembly/reimplementation. Preserve as a binary-preservation lead rather than mislabel as recovered source.

decisions.title: Alien Soldier repository transfer
decisions.reason: Same GitHub repository ID 594776335: old oranguthang URL returns Moved Permanently to that numeric repository, while new RetrolariumLab metadata has that ID. Correct canonical owner without duplicating project.

decisions.title: C64 BASIC Crusher
decisions.reason: Browser source preprocessor maps long variable names and labels into compact C64 BASIC forms. Concrete tokenizer/name maps inspected; not machine-code compilation or proof of arbitrary BASIC semantic equivalence.

decisions.title: Commodore BASIC variable dumper
decisions.reason: Inspects BASIC V2 scalar/string/array state in memory dumps or through VICE remote monitor. Requires appropriate address coverage and has explicit unsupported cases; source analysis performed without connecting to an emulator.

decisions.title: FileCore Mountin filesystem continuation
decisions.reason: RISC OS FileCore source with independently maintained Mountin contributions, defaulting to fixed-media/old-directory feature branch. Preserve original FileCore lineage and branch identity; concrete workspace/cache code is not proof every filesystem variant is supported.

decisions.title: micro-PROLOG Backtracked
decisions.reason: Browser recreation of micro-PROLOG and SIMPLE workflows with concrete unification, occurs check and trail unwinding. Author had no original source and explicitly allows behavioral differences; symbolic AI subject matter is not AI-authorship evidence.

decisions.title: BBC Micro GoSDC tools archive
decisions.reason: GoSDC documentation, media scripts and C++ Acorn-drive parsing tools under one root. No root README, but actual implementation is present; large generated shell inventories and bundled materials must not inflate apparent original code scope.

decisions.title: beebtools BBC disc and BASIC suite
decisions.reason: DFS and old-map ADFS image handling plus dialect-aware BBC BASIC tokenization/detokenization. Side-qualified filenames and specific S/M/L formats matter; current source includes more than read-only catalog viewing.

decisions.title: cpclib Amstrad CPC development suite
decisions.reason: Coherent multi-crate assembler/disassembler, media, image, build, emulator-control and IDE tooling. Inspected concrete assembler output-control logic; README warns evolving subset support and older demos may need matching toolchain revision. Do not split every crate into duplicate projects.

decisions.title: MSX REA media analysis toolkit
decisions.reason: ROM/DISK triage, mapper heuristics and evidence-report pipeline exposed through CLI/MCP. Bank-write counts are explicitly heuristic, not mapper proof; LLM client integration is capability, not evidence the project was AI-authored.

decisions.title: PSGlib Sega PSG replay library
decisions.reason: SN76489 VGM conversion/compression and Z80 background music/SFX player. Requires steady frame calls and proper bank mapping, with separate music/SFX updates. Format-specific playback library rather than generic VGM support.

decisions.title: smstilemap Sega graphics tools
decisions.reason: Raster-to-tile/palette/name-table conversion with horizontal and vertical duplicate detection. Nearest palette conversion can change appearance; data emitted as assembly is not Z80 program compilation.

decisions.title: IT to SN76489 VGM converter
decisions.reason: Converts specially authored Impulse Tracker modules through concrete IT parser and SN76489 mapping. Channel-priority and hardware limits apply; not an arbitrary sampled-module player or universally faithful audio conversion.

decisions.title: Bitsy Master System prototype
decisions.reason: Inherited generic Bitsy README obscures actual SMS base-ROM engine and banked resource reader. Concrete C implementation and build present; classify as prototype adaptation with upstream Bitsy lineage, not empty documentation or a fully compatible finished port.

decisions.title: mdxmini X68000 music library
decisions.reason: Host C MDX/PDX playback and metadata API with YM2151/PCM synthesis. Source music platform does not impose 68000 host CPU; sample assets may be external and titles may be Shift-JIS.

decisions.title: libzm2 X68000 Z-MUSIC interface
decisions.reason: Header-only C wrappers for Z-MUSIC v2 calls using inline assembly and error safeguards. Requires installed driver and compiler-specific features for work structures; not an independent music driver implementation.

decisions.title: libcondrv X68000 console library
decisions.reason: Console-driver buffer, key-paste and hook wrappers with concrete Human68k calls. UTF-8 repository source must be converted to Shift-JIS for native build; requires condrv/em driver and preserves GPL runtime exception distinction.

decisions.title: X68000 LIBC source archive
decisions.reason: Project LIBC Group historical library normalized to UTF-8/LF by archive maintainer. Concrete IOCS-backed routines present; repository explicitly does not provide a maintained build workflow or collect unofficial patches, so refer to original archives.

decisions.title: X68000 ADPCM helper library
decisions.reason: Header-only IOCS wrappers and recorder/player examples with rate/output modes and busy polling. Nonblocking calls require caller buffer lifetime and completion handling; this is hardware access glue, not a software ADPCM codec.

decisions.title: Link's Awakening DX disassembly
decisions.reason: Multiple regional/revision ROM targets and Virtual Console patches with symbolic game/audio source. README identifies exact expected hashes and RGBDS version; no local rebuild or full annotation completeness independently established.

decisions.title: Tetris Game Boy disassembly
decisions.reason: Concrete RGBDS source including serial interrupts and status dispatch. Upstream claims exact World ROM rebuild but lists unfinished code/data annotation and discrepancies; exactness does not mean complete semantic understanding.

decisions.title: Pokemon Gold/Silver Space World prototypes
decisions.reason: 1997 demo disassembly with separate Gold/Silver debug and nondebug targets and corrected-header variants. Concrete audio engine and source tree inspected; prototypes are not retail Gold/Silver and corrected-header builds have distinct hashes.

decisions.title: Ghidra NES parsing scripts
decisions.reason: Small work-in-progress iNES parser and Ghidra loader helpers. Header extraction is real, but hard-coded vector offsets and limited loader code prevent treating it as universal mapper support or complete game decompilation.

decisions.title: Ghidra NES ROM analysis extension
decisions.reason: iNES import, NES memory map, labels and 6502 language integration. Explicit mapper scope is NROM/0; tested Ghidra 10.0.3 does not establish current-version compatibility or automated recovery of complete source.

decisions.title: Neo Geo Palette Finder
decisions.reason: Visual palette-candidate PNG generation from raw ROM/memory bytes, including shifted alignment. Concrete GML bit decoding inspected; not a semantic palette locator. Source comment explicitly credits a ChatGPT-assisted size calculation, not whole-project authorship.

decisions.title: Dotemu Neo Geo Pocket-format converter
decisions.reason: Rearranges specific Dotemu ROM component layouts for an Analogue Pocket Neo Geo core, inspired by dotemu2mame. Filename assumptions and learning-project scope retained; no ROM acquired or modified and no universal set compatibility claimed.

decisions.title: PS2 icon database and extractor
decisions.reason: Root combines icon preservation website and concrete PS2 memory-card/icon parsing tools. Extractor derives from mymc+/mymc and handles save formats; metadata/animation extraction is not game decompilation. Oversized tree handled with targeted extractor traversal.

decisions.title: TRS-80 terminal and transfer tools
decisions.reason: BASIC terminal, Intel HEX helpers and actual assembly terminal code including Model 4 variant. README checklist lags source; do not call assembly absent, but ANSI/keyboard and robust transfer completeness remain unproven.

decisions.title: um80 MACRO-80 compatible toolchain
decisions.reason: Assembler, linker, librarian, cross-reference, disassembler and syntax translator. REL-format implementation documents Microsoft versus DRI differences and extended symbols; compatible subset and extensions must not be conflated with unrestricted original-tool equivalence.

decisions.title: 1985 Amstrad PCW emulator
decisions.reason: SDL3 PCW 8256/8512/9512 emulation with ASIC, disk, keyboard and roller-RAM video. Sibling of CPC 1984 but distinct platform hardware; model guest RAM is not host minimum. Disk writes persist, no emulator or media was run here.

decisions.title: Z80 recompilation semantic runtime
decisions.reason: Reusable packed-state ABI and instruction semantics extracted for SMS/GG and Genesis recompiler consumers. No decoder, emitter, platform bus or game source here; sms_ callback names do not make it SMS-only. SuperZazu and noncommercial glue provenance retained.

decisions.title: Applesoft BASIC cassette encoder
decisions.reason: Converts Applesoft source into tokenized cassette WAV with length/flag/checksum and pulse encoding. Audio transport tool, not BASIC-to-machine-code compiler; physical playback and target loading were not tested.

decisions.title: Lemonade Stand C# source port
decisions.reason: Direct adaptation of 1979 Applesoft BASIC with original statements retained in comments and tests. Source-derived port, not binary decompilation; README's planned refactoring does not establish behavior-perfect modern reconstruction. Compared with tracked lars-erik version: this uses direct BASIC-commented Game.cs, while the other uses separate command/domain/calculation classes; shared original subject is not URL identity or duplicated code architecture.

decisions.title: VideoFX experimental Amiga graphics library
decisions.reason: Headers, copper merge/sort code and design notes for graphics supplement/replacement. Sparse unfinished-looking implementation does not establish a complete drop-in graphics.library replacement or all advertised sprite/blitter features; no build/runtime flags asserted.

decisions.title: MyAmigaLibrary graphics helpers
decisions.reason: Concrete View, GELS/BOB and ILBM extraction helpers. README explicitly says extracted image layout is unsuitable for VSprites/simple sprites; shared helper code is not a replacement OS graphics library or general IFF implementation.

decisions.title: Macintosh MFS Python extractor
decisions.reason: Traverses MFS allocation/directory data and writes DATA/RSRC forks plus Finder-info bytes. Raw historical image extractor, not HFS or a mounted filesystem; speculative physical floppy use is not tested capability.

decisions.title: Macintosh MFS image creator
decisions.reason: Rust port of Mountin's C MFS creation code with directory flattening and allocation/file limits. Finder folders are not on-disk directories; reject colon-name clashes and preserve original port lineage, separate from MFS reader tools.

decisions.title: Acorn 6502 Client ROM disassembly
decisions.reason: Working disassembly of version 1.10 Tube client ROM with build/disassembly scripts and alternate emtube material. No root README needed to establish source; not a disassembly of the whole host MOS or all co-processors.

decisions.title: Acorn NFS 3.34 disassembly
decisions.reason: Generated assembly plus Py8Dis annotation program labels Econet/NFS routines, registers and mixed data. Specific 8 KiB ROM version; tooling source is reproducible annotation evidence, not independent source recovery of every NFS release.

decisions.title: CMS 6809 monitor ROM disassemblies
decisions.reason: Monitor ROM dumps and annotated source for multiple CMS boards with f9dasm/lwasm conversion/check workflow. Microware DEBUG source provided comment lineage; board variants and initial DEBUG09 dump formats remain distinct.

decisions.title: VET 3000 video titler restoration
decisions.reason: Brazilian titler firmware v2.1 annotated reassembly, measured/referenced hardware evidence and playable demonstration cartridge source. Concrete cold-start/VDP setup inspected; approximate schematics and upstream byte/MAME claims retain their evidence limits.

decisions.title: Debug and DebugX DOS debugger suite
decisions.reason: MS DEBUG-style debugger extended with assembler/disassembler, FPU and DPMI variants. CPU/mode support differs among Debug/DebugX and extensions; source instruction support is not a universal runtime minimum or unrestricted modern x86 coverage.

decisions.title: Original QuickDraw source archive
decisions.reason: Bill Atkinson's original QuickDraw source mirrored from Computer History Museum material; actual BitBlt and graphics routines inspected. Apple notice permits noncommercial use only, not a general open-source licence; historical source not a current build.

decisions.title: Oric Screen Editor
decisions.reason: Native text-screen/charset editor with serial attributes and viewport helpers, derived from VDCSE. File picker is limited to SEDORIC3 disks made by TAP2DSK; storage/canvas constraints explicit and advertised editing features not independently runtime-tested.

decisions.title: Dreamcast documentation aggregation
decisions.reason: Useful curated offline manual archive, but the inspected reverse-engineering quirks file is a topic list awaiting expansion, not original analysis or implementation. Keep as a research source lead rather than promote as an independent restoration project; individual documents retain their copyrights.

decisions.reason: Primary repository evidence establishes a distinct in-scope retro-development or software-archaeology project; the matching project audit records CPU, build, runtime and uncertainty boundaries explicitly.

decisions.title: tom-seddon/acorn_mos_refreshed
decisions.reason: The repository explicitly says it is an offshoot used only for independent refreshed-ROM releases and points documentation, issues and source back to the already tracked Acorn MOS disassembly project.

decisions.title: tom-seddon/beeb
decisions.reason: The primary README describes a miscellaneous grab bag and only broadly mentions Python scripts; no coherent separately titled project was established from the root page.

decisions.title: TobyLobster/mos
decisions.reason: The queued repository currently returned no accessible root README through the GitHub contents API; inspect its tree/default branch before deciding whether it contains a distinct project.

decisions.title: TobyLobster/GXR-pages
decisions.reason: The queued repository currently returned no accessible root README through the GitHub contents API; inspect its tree/default branch before deciding whether this is a project site or independent development work.

decisions.title: amiga-re-kit — measured Amiga reverse-engineering toolkit
decisions.reason: Game-agnostic extraction of instruments from SWIV, Turrican II and Superfrog projects. ADF/HUNK readers, checksum-aware unpackers, conservative 68000 walking, MCP and capture comparison are implemented. Recompiler is explicitly a prototype with a restricted blitter/custom-chip model; unmodelled accesses are logged, not proof of a complete native game port.

decisions.title: dsktools — CPC physical-floppy imaging tools
decisions.reason: Reads and writes DSK/EDSK through the Linux floppy-controller interface. Standard and some unusual geometries are documented; faithful recreation of every protection scheme remains future work.

decisions.title: Python CPC demo tools
decisions.reason: Historical Z80 syntax checks, vasm symbol extraction and additional graphics/sound helpers. The regex checker explicitly is incomplete, not a full assembler frontend.

decisions.title: Palware — annotated historical DOS malware disassemblies
decisions.reason: Archived educational static-analysis collection of DOS-era specimens. The author describes removing destructive disk-overwrite code, so these are modified analytical listings, not byte-exact original binaries. No specimen was assembled or executed.

decisions.title: Cocktail Soft CSR cursor conversion tools
decisions.reason: Converts planar four-bit cursor images to/from PNG, with splitting/consolidation that preserves unknown leading header data. Travel Junction is the primary target; Pia Carrot MOUSE.DAT is additionally documented.

decisions.title: CONMOD — X68000 console and graphics-mode inspector
decisions.reason: Queries and changes Human68k DOS console, IOCS display and GraphicMask settings. Source explicitly selects .cpu 68000.

decisions.title: PictOric — constrained Oric image conversion
decisions.reason: Error-diffusion conversion respects Oric 240×200 graphics attributes and emits TAP with an optional BASIC loader plus BMP preview. Runs as GrafX2 script or command-line Lua.

decisions.title: CP/M-86 CMD executable tools
decisions.reason: Inspects/extracts CMD groups, modifies groups and converts flat/H86 input. The 8080 model name is a CP/M-86 loading model, not proof of an 8080 target CPU. exe2cmd is specifically constrained to a Personal CP/M-86 BDOS small-model image, not a general DOS application converter.

decisions.title: 6809-DISASM — native position-independent disassembler
decisions.reason: A callable 6809 single-instruction decoder with pointer-based string output, not an interactive host disassembly suite.

decisions.title: BRRtools — SNES sample encoding and extraction
decisions.reason: BRR encoder/decoder and SPC sample extraction, with resampling, loop handling and optional Gaussian filtering. PS1 audio support appears only as a future plan.

decisions.title: Game Boy APU behavioural test ROM
decisions.reason: Native sound-sequence tests exercise tone, envelope, sweep, waveform, noise and terminal routing. Implemented channel routines provide timed register sequences; this is a test input suite, not an emulator implementation or independently validated fidelity result.

decisions.title: mdtools — Mega Drive graphics and music analysis
decisions.reason: Source expands the sparse README: mapping/DPLC tools, artwork splitting/recoloring, FM voice handling and SMPS-to-assembly conversion are present.

decisions.title: Nintendo 64 SDK audio-tool decompilation
decisions.reason: Recovered host-side ADPCM encoding/decoding and codebook/table-design sources. The visible tree does not represent every SDK developer tool, nor a Nintendo 64 game decompilation.

decisions.title: Castlevania 64 — matching decompilation
decisions.reason: Work-in-progress matching C reconstruction with game-state implementation and asset recovery. Upstream explicitly warns that hardcoded addresses limit shiftability and large-scale mods.

decisions.title: neosdconv — NeoSD ROM-container converter
decisions.reason: Combines component P/S/M/V/C ROM files into NeoSD .neo containers with metadata. Exotic images including Bad Apple and possibly SS5 Perfect are documented exceptions.

decisions.title: Sailor Moon PC Engine CD translation source
decisions.reason: Translation patch materials include script/font extraction, assembly modifications and disc reconstruction. Honorifics flag also selects original versus translated images.

decisions.title: saprtools — cross-chip music conversion to POKEY
decisions.reason: Converts multiple chip/music formats into SAP-R and low-overhead POKEY playback. It explicitly does not make POKEY an exact SID/AY emulator; timer-driven effects, digidrums and rapid envelopes have limits.

decisions.title: fat95 — maintained Amiga FAT filesystem handler
decisions.reason: Maintained continuation of Torsten Jager fat95 3.18 for FAT12/16/32, with MBR/GPT integration. A filesystem handler is distinct from the required low-level device driver.

decisions.title: Chedit — Atari ST font editor’s Linux continuation
decisions.reason: Historical font editor port now edits PSF-style VGA-console fonts through curses. Source and README preserve Atari ST ancestry, but current code is not advertised as an Atari executable.

decisions.title: te — CP/M text editor and machine adaptations
decisions.reason: Native screen editor with machine-specific terminal/input adaptations. Text is kept in available TPA; functionality can be configured out to conserve space.

decisions.title: PAL — restored Commodore assembler sources
decisions.reason: Original PAL source made readable/buildable with xa65. Mixed BASIC/assembly and relocatable output are separate flavours, not simultaneous features.

decisions.title: Sargon II VIC-20 — annotated relocation and opening-book repair
decisions.reason: Annotated engine relocated to RAM, with optional Sargon 2.1 CP/M opening-book replacement. Source explains the original missing book-table byte and changed RESTORE behaviour; this is not an unchanged cartridge reconstruction.

decisions.title: AFPBridge — Apple IIgs AFP-over-TCP bridge
decisions.reason: Redirects existing AppleShare FST traffic through TCP/IP rather than replacing the FST. AFP 2.0/optional 2.2 compatibility is explicit; AFP 3.x-only servers are unsupported.

decisions.title: Mehmood Spectrum compiler — incomplete type-in preservation
decisions.reason: Preserves scans, OCR article and typed BASIC compiler listings from 1985. Maintainer explicitly reports failure even on a small BORDER example and suspects transcription or original-listing errors; working tape version remains missing.

decisions.title: Theme Park DOS resource viewer
decisions.reason: Views/extracts Theme Park floppy/CD sprites, palettes, animation and sound resources. Music playback is explicitly experimental.

decisions.title: Coleco cartridge header inspector
decisions.reason: Small source-only header inspector prints magic, table pointers, entry address and name. Direct indexing/name scanning lacks a clear malformed-input bounds guard, so it is not a robust universal dump validator.

decisions.title: TI-99/4A cassette de/encoder
decisions.reason: WAV decoding/encoding, raw-program conversion and BASIC listing with documented cassette format and debug-wave diagnostics.

decisions.title: ColecoDS Phoenix — multi-system DS/DSi emulator
decisions.reason: General multi-system emulator rather than a game-specific emulation port. Source has Z80, 6502, VDP and sound components; guest machines share hardware but have individual media and BIOS constraints.

decisions.title: PokeyForge — RMT instrument inspection and editing
decisions.reason: Inspects/edits RTI instruments and builds RMT banks through a real tracker-driver/emulated-6502/POKEY chain. Source describes working copies and explicit bank saves rather than overwriting originals.

decisions.title: C64 memory model — C# assembly/disassembly backend
decisions.reason: C# library models PRG memory, bookmarks, characters and assembler/disassembler operations, with a related sprite editor. It is not a complete C64 emulator.

decisions.title: fuseadf — Amiga image filesystem bridge
decisions.reason: libfuse/ADFlib filesystem for OFS/FFS volumes. Defaults to read-write; read-only requires -o ro. Single-thread operation is enforced because concurrent writes can corrupt images.

decisions.title: Atari ST GCC wrapper and PRG assembler
decisions.reason: Wraps m68k-linux-gnu-gcc-8 assembly output and custom gas68k assembler to produce TOS PRG files. It cannot link multiple object files; source inclusion is the documented workaround.

decisions.title: kz80_chip8 — CHIP-8 to native Z80 recompiler
decisions.reason: Translates CHIP-8 opcodes to Z80 ROM plus runtime, with ACIA text rendering of the 64×32 display. Translation direction is CHIP-8→Z80, not Z80→host; shipped game inputs do not prove full compatibility.

decisions.title: BBC Lisp — native 6502 interpreter
decisions.reason: Interpreted Lisp implementation includes evaluation, reading, printing and mark/sweep GC. README marks tail calls/GC done but notes no string type and inadequate error handling; compilation examples are incomplete.

decisions.title: Dec-ROM — scrambled EPROM bit-wiring recovery
decisions.reason: Manual address/data permutation and bounded heuristic Auto-Fix for scrambled EPROMs. Auto-Fix is explicitly Z80-only despite additional decoder modules; known wiring patterns are tried before general search. Confidence threshold is described as uncalibrated, not proof of universal recovery.

decisions.title: CoCo DskTools — headerless JVC disk library
decisions.reason: Library/CLI for CoCo DECB virtual disks, file extraction/insertion and formatting. It says JVC format but explicitly neither creates nor recognises a JVC header.

decisions.title: stjeanp/applesoft-basic-decompiler
decisions.reason: GitHub comparison with already tracked moralrecordings upstream is identical: zero ahead, zero behind. No distinct implementation to add.

decisions.title: cpcitor/dsktools
decisions.reason: Compared with BackupTheBerlios/dsktools: one added README commit only, no code changes. Promote original source archive once.

decisions.title: thomasdenney/microjit
decisions.reason: False platform match: ARM JIT for BBC micro:bit, not the 6502 BBC Micro. module.json names microbit dependencies.

decisions.title: tomWangTomWang/PC98-Game-Translator
decisions.reason: Generic screenshot translation pipeline rather than PC-98 binary/format restoration. Backend uses local Qwen inference and hardcoded local paths; README references absent requirements files. AI inference is not evidence of AI-authored implementation. Retain only as a lead until a distinct preservation/development role is established.

decisions.title: AProSys — historical Amiga music tracker sources
decisions.reason: Historical tracker source archive with two differently aged source trees. Author cannot confidently identify the final version; src-q/ad.c explicitly is not the version used in AProSys.

decisions.title: C64 search-and-replace — streaming disk text utility
decisions.reason: Streams SEQ/PRG files through variable-length text replacement. The README contains the actual BASIC listing, despite the tree otherwise presenting PRG files. BASIC links can be repaired; fixed-offset machine code is not safe after length changes.

decisions.title: ZX tape master — WAV inspection and TAP recovery
decisions.reason: Qt waveform/block interface supports processing selections, noise/frequency controls, filtering, channel changes and TAP output. Source is substantive despite no README. WAV parser expects specific PCM/chunk layouts, not arbitrary audio formats.

decisions.title: PZX tools — Spectrum pulse-format conversion
decisions.reason: TZX/TAP/CSW to PZX, PZX to WAV, and editable textual pulse/block representation. Documentation specifies TZX 1.20 and CSW 1.01/2.00; do not infer support for future revisions.

decisions.title: bbc-disk — BBC DFS image builder
decisions.reason: Builds a DFS SSD image from files with load/execute addresses and optional generated !BOOT. Fixed 80-track, 10-sector, 256-byte geometry is not universal Acorn disk-format support.

decisions.title: CiderPress II — Apple II and vintage Macintosh media tools
decisions.reason: Archive/disk inspection, extraction and conversion with format-identification and nested-container handling. CLI and Windows GUI have different host support; format recognition is not universal read/write support.

decisions.title: dsk2woz2 — Apple II sector-image conversion
decisions.reason: Converts standard 35-track, 16-sector, 256-byte DSK input to WOZ2. Source-level defect: extension loop overwrites has_p and has_dot from the same character, making their conjunction false; documented ProDOS-order detection is not established as working.

decisions.title: Mac::ResFork — classic Macintosh resource-fork parser
decisions.reason: Reads classic pre-OS-X resource-fork types, names and data. AppleDouble handling in inspected implementation assumes a fixed layout; do not infer full modern filesystem/container support.

decisions.title: dcc — DOS executable decompiler continuation
decisions.reason: Historical DOS-to-C decompiler substantially reworked with a Qt frontend and MZ/PSP loading. Memory models, arrays and recovery remain constrained; historical binaries do not establish that current source builds.

decisions.title: qb30decomp — QuickBASIC 3 executable recovery
decisions.reason: Recovers BASIC from BRUN30 QuickBASIC 3 executables, including COMMON chains and floating-evaluation-order preservation. BCOM30 /O is unsupported; multi-module binaries only recover the first module. Some constant-index arrays become scalars, changing layout.

decisions.title: Cyber Block Metal Orange — PC-98 English translation
decisions.reason: Two-disk translation rebuild handles PRECO on Disk A and FAT12 on Disk B, with input hash checks, script/image changes and IPS output. ERC VFD is a container, not an HDM rename; emulator in-memory saves require explicit flushing.

decisions.title: ToolShed — CoCo and Dragon media and development suite
decisions.reason: OS-9/DECB disk tools and historical ROM/compiler sources. Microware C material explicitly needs work; optional DiskShed GUI has a separate build. It is not uniformly complete simply because several components work.

decisions.title: Z8E — CP/M symbolic screen debugger
decisions.reason: Historical debugger continuation with symbol loading, terminal adaptation and a conditional HD64180/Z180 build. Version 4.2 fixes symbol files ending exactly at a record boundary.

decisions.title: A09 — Motorola-family cross assembler
decisions.reason: Assembler covers several 6800/6801/6809/6301/6309/68HC11-family modes and binary, Intel HEX, S-record and FLEX relocatable outputs. RELASMB compatibility was reverse engineered and is not an exhaustive compatibility guarantee.

decisions.title: DiztinGUIsh — trace-assisted SNES disassembler
decisions.reason: Combines SNES ROM mapping, labels and emulator trace/CDL information including 65816 register-width context. Importer respects the selected mapping rather than retaining inconsistent detected offsets.

decisions.title: BattleTanx GBC — annotated disassembly
decisions.reason: RGBDS assembly reconstruction of the USA 1 MiB MBC5 CGB-only game. Named routines and asset boundaries are present; author byte-exact and coverage totals are not independent verification. Unreferenced bytes retain unknown purpose.

decisions.title: SegaSaturn.NET.Imaging — texture conversion library
decisions.reason: Loads bitmap/TGA and width-height-prefixed 16-bit texture data, converts Saturn colors/textures, writes PNG/TGA and handles selected transparency. Sparse README is supplemented by implementation evidence.

decisions.title: Ocarina of Time — native Dreamcast port
decisions.reason: Native SH-4 port using recovered OOT game code, PowerVR display-list translation and AICA audio. Display-list interpretation is not MIPS CPU emulation. Only gc-eu-mq-dbg input is documented, not every retail ROM.

decisions.title: PaRappa the Rapper 2 — PS2 prototype decompilation
decisions.reason: Work-in-progress reconstruction targets the July 12 NTSC-J prototype, not all retail variants. Source includes main game and IOP-module interfaces. Hardcoded overlay addresses and unrecovered details remain.

decisions.title: JagTris — historical Atari Jaguar game source
decisions.reason: Historical homebrew Tetris source with 68000 host code and GPU game/rendering components, continued with newer tooling. Not a commercial game decompilation.

decisions.title: hacktools — multi-platform translation and ROM utilities
decisions.reason: Reusable extraction/repacking, graphics, text, compression and patch helpers. WonderSwan implementation splits 64 KiB banks and recalculates checksums; other platforms have individual constraints.

decisions.title: bmp2swan — WonderSwan tile converter
decisions.reason: Converts indexed BMP to WonderSwan Color chunky tiles, optionally deduplicating mirrored map tiles; -4col emits monochrome planar data. Output modes must not be conflated.

decisions.title: Rhythm Heaven — Nintendo DS decompilation
decisions.reason: Early recovered functions and overlay configuration for USA Rev 0 YLZE01. Original ROM supplies unrecovered material; presence of a build system does not mean the game is fully reconstructed.

decisions.title: Space Cadet Pinball — Nintendo DS port
decisions.reason: Native DS/DSi adaptation of the reverse-engineered Space Cadet engine. Full Tilt CADET data is reported nonworking, and DS downscaling/light issues differ from DSi.

decisions.title: MicroAllegrex — PSP decompiler instruction support
decisions.reason: Hex-Rays MIPS microcode extension for selected Allegrex operations including bitrev, mfic, min/max and wsbw. mtic and instructions in delay slots remain unsupported.

decisions.title: GSFORTH ROM — BBC Micro Forth restoration
decisions.reason: ROM rework of historical GSFORTH includes subroutine-threaded Forth and block storage with readable 6502 assembly. Modern changes mean it is not an unchanged 1983 binary.

decisions.title: BBC Forth — Z80 second-processor port
decisions.reason: Port derived from Acornsoft Forth disassembly, retaining a 6502 host stub while running Forth on the Z80 second processor. Interactive but incomplete, with unit tests documented.

decisions.title: orictape — cassette-waveform and BASIC inspection
decisions.reason: Reads WAV samples into tape streams, flags suspect bits/checksums and renders tokenized BASIC. Editing and TAP/WAV export are TODOs, despite the broader repository description.

decisions.title: PcW16 Typeface Preservation — pixel and metric capture
decisions.reason: Rosanne-native capture draws glyphs on white/black backgrounds, reads pixels and metrics, then creates BDF and pixel-outline TTF. It does not extract original scalable-font outlines. Captured fonts/OS files are not shipped.

decisions.title: PokeLink — Neo Geo Pocket cartridge linker utility
decisions.reason: Pocket Linker parallel-port cartridge backup/write/verify source. Current master is explicitly untested by the maintainer because suitable parallel-port hardware is unavailable.

decisions.title: MACScnv — X68000 animation build helper
decisions.reason: Generates batch files, assembly and file lists to combine prepared images/audio into MACS animation. It orchestrates existing image/ADPCM/assembler/linker tools rather than implementing every converter itself.

decisions.title: Detokenizers — multi-dialect BASIC source recovery
decisions.reason: Collection of BASIC listing converters, not a single full interpreter. Microsoft dialect testing varies; Sorcerer/Nascom/OSI variants are explicitly untested and ZBasic token maps incomplete. Top-level README describes ancestry rather than full current scope.

decisions.title: xdms-rs — Amiga DMS decompression in Rust
decisions.reason: Already tracked as xdms-rs-amiga-dms. Fresh source inspection found unequal per-mode fixture coverage and explicit Claude assistance; no duplicate entry added. Preserve those limits when refreshing the existing audit.

decisions.title: Oaknut — Acorn media and metadata toolkit
decisions.reason: Unified Acorn disk/archive/BASIC toolkit with DFS/ADFS/AFS components and metadata-preserving ZIP handling. Parser resolves SparkFS, INF and filename metadata; per-filesystem operations differ.

decisions.title: DjPoke/RetroCloner
decisions.reason: Modern Lua/LOVE2D visual editor imitates retro aesthetics, but inspected sources do not establish native retro output or a reversing/preservation role. Do not infer native platform support from styling.

decisions.title: EmeraldNova/SHREC
decisions.reason: Saturn research and Jo Engine tutorial/example collection, not a separately buildable implementation in the inspected tree. Retain as a research source rather than promote a duplicate engine/tool project.

decisions.title: rob-smallshire/oaknut-zip
decisions.reason: Archived package explicitly moved into rob-smallshire/oaknut. Promote the coherent canonical monorepo once; preserve old import namespace and migration relationship.

decisions.title: BBC ROM sources — HostFS and RAM Manager
decisions.reason: Related native ROM sources include serial/user-port filing systems and restored sideways-RAM management. Board-specific features are conditionally omitted; HostFS serial polling has timing limitations.

decisions.title: AppleIIDev — Merlin32 development workflow
decisions.reason: Source examples and reusable graphics routines with Node/VSCode tasks that assemble, replace files in a disk image and launch AppleWin. This is a development workflow, not a new assembler or game reconstruction.

decisions.title: Fugløy — TRS-80 reversing and execution workbench
decisions.reason: CMD/BASIC/raw disassembly, annotation/JSON IR, assembler and deterministic emulator feed observed coverage back into analysis. Recursive descent leaves unreached bytes unknown and diagnoses overlaps. Web and MCP interfaces share core libraries.

decisions.title: Micro64 Disk Tool — C64 media conversion
decisions.reason: Converts among D64, G64, P64, FDI, NIB and KryoFlux streams, with track/pulse diagnostics. Sector representations cannot preserve physical information absent from their format.

decisions.title: mkd64 — modular C64 disk-image builder
decisions.reason: Core track/sector writer with CBM DOS directory, extra-track and separator modules; supports per-file placement/interleave. Unknown options can be silently ignored because modules interpret them.

decisions.title: BitPast — native retro graphics and media conversion
decisions.reason: macOS converter implements platform-specific image layouts and native exports rather than merely retro visual filters. Inspected CPC source exposes mode-specific packing and palette processing; other mode and disk claims are upstream documentation, not exhaustive validation.

decisions.title: Crossware 68000XR — BBC-hosted assembler disassembly
decisions.reason: Annotated reconstruction of the BBC sideways ROM for a 68000 cross assembler. Python explicitly loads the ROM as 65C02: 68000 is the generated instruction set, not the CPU executing this ROM.

decisions.title: ulzexe — Rust LZEXE executable unpacker
decisions.reason: Port of UNLZEXE supporting LZEXE 0.90/0.91 MZ/ZM images, reconstructed relocation tables and bounds-checked input. Not a universal DOS unpacker or C decompiler.

decisions.title: GeoPatcher — Variable Geo II translation tools
decisions.reason: Extracts/edits Shift-JIS text and patches halfwidth display for vanilla VG2 and the Perfect Collection revision. Offsets differ between versions and must be re-extracted.

decisions.title: Lodoss PC-98 — translation and reinsertion experiments
decisions.reason: Sparse source-only translation workspace. Inspected Lodoss 1 reinserter enforces field byte lengths, pads text, applies fixed-offset edits and writes new game/scenario HDM images. Description mentions both games, but inspected implementation does not establish complete support for Lodoss 2.

decisions.title: CRTCHK — X68000 display diagnostics
decisions.reason: Native IOCS-based CRT/LCD test patterns enumerate 15/24/31 kHz modes and color/VRAM layouts. It is a display diagnostic, not a source reconstruction or universal monitor compatibility test.

decisions.title: Twin Bee MSX — annotated cartridge reconstruction
decisions.reason: Generated annotated listing with address-bound notes, explicit indirect entry hints, graphics decoders and openMSX VRAM comparisons. Full 32 KiB explanation/matching and 21 tests are upstream measurements, not independent verification.

decisions.title: Oric tools — preserved tape, disk and BASIC utilities
decisions.reason: Historical Euphoric-associated format tools include BASIC tokenization, assemblers, plotter rendering and disk conversion. This root adds smaller Sedoric-image configuration support. Empty primary README does not mean absent implementation.

decisions.title: TapeRipper — native Oric tape-to-disk preservation
decisions.reason: Loads tape blocks on the original machine and writes numbered disk files; includes multipart and slow-tape modes. This is distinct from modern WAV decoding.

decisions.title: ZSM4 — native relocatable Z80-family assembler
decisions.reason: Disk-based macro assembler supports Z80/Z180/Z280 instruction sets, conditional assembly and REL output suitable for L80/LINK. Source includes explicit relocatable-record generation.

decisions.title: CPM-65 — 6502 operating system and utilities
decisions.reason: Author-maintained CP/M-like BIOS/BDOS/CCP and native utilities including assembler, BASIC and Forth. Nearly compatible disk directory is not 8080 binary compatibility; programs load at $0200.

decisions.title: 8088ify — 8080 CP/M to 8086 DOS source translator
decisions.reason: Mechanical assembly translator maps instructions and selected BDOS/reboot calls. No macros, incomplete ! line separation and 255-character line limit; manual repair can be necessary. It is not CPU emulation.

decisions.title: Street Fighter III — unlicensed NES disassembly
decisions.reason: Banked disassembly of the unlicensed 9 Fighter NES title, not Capcom arcade Street Fighter III. Build scripts assemble named banks and append graphics/header data.

decisions.title: SNES decompression tools — game-specific format research
decisions.reason: Collection of game-specific graphics/text/tile decompressors and some compressors. Inspected Ardy Lightfoot source uses a fixed ROM name, fixed offset and small buffers; not an automatic generic SNES format detector.

decisions.title: Game Boy serial-link monitor ROM
decisions.reason: Native external-clock link receiver prints ASCII/hex bytes via serial and VBlank interrupts. Source warns of a high-volume data bug in its 255-byte queue; not a lossless general serial analyser.

decisions.title: AS Sonic — modified historical cross assembler
decisions.reason: Modified Macro-Assembler AS used by Mega Drive Sonic disassemblies. Includes genuine code generators, not game source itself; historical host portability statements are not current verified builds.

decisions.title: Astal — Saturn symbol maps and reversing tools
decisions.reason: US MK-81019 analysis publishes function maps, provisional names, Ghidra scripts and cross-overlay transfer tools, but no recovered C or game binaries. Zero placeholders is not semantic completeness; thousands of names remain provisional.

decisions.title: Nippon — Okami PC-port modding framework
decisions.reason: Early archive/model inspection and editing for Okami data_pc, including scene viewer and standalone utilities. PlayStation search provenance must not become a claim of PS2 media compatibility.

decisions.title: Snowboard Kids 2 — N64 matching C reconstruction
decisions.reason: Matching reconstruction and asset extraction from an owned big-endian ROM, explicitly not a PC port. Code still contains unknown names and partial structure views; a matching build is not semantic completion.

decisions.title: Virtual Pro-Wrestling 2 — decompilation and annotated assembly
decisions.reason: Work-in-progress game reconstruction with named combat routines and data annotations. Human-editable asset conversion and further recovery remain unfinished.

decisions.title: neoconv — Neo Geo container and ROM-set tools
decisions.reason: Packs/extracts .neo and MAME/Darksoft layouts, edits header metadata, handles C interleaving and optional P-bank half swap. Auto-detection is a reset-vector plausibility heuristic, not proof for every hack or unusual image.

decisions.title: NES2PCE — cross-console graphics conversion
decisions.reason: Converts palette, CHR and raw nametable data into PC Engine assembly, with an example display program. RLE nametables are unsupported and palette mapping is manually adjustable.

decisions.title: Fight for Life — restored Jaguar source build
decisions.reason: Reconstructs missing pieces around original FFLSRC.ZIP and modernizes build tooling. Retail versus modified/no-trailer outputs are separate; retail identity includes trailer bytes and regenerated security prefix.

decisions.title: 3it — 3DO graphics conversion and inspection
decisions.reason: Image conversion covers CEL/IMAG/LRFORM, palettes and selected NFS containers. No dithering, incomplete CEL option combinations and directional format limits remain. ANIM output and NFS wwww writing are TODOs despite broad introductory wording.

decisions.title: Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days — DS matching-module reconstruction
decisions.reason: EU YKGP ARM9/overlay reconstruction reports all 306 modules matching, while distinguishing C, library assembly and two CLZ exceptions. Matching modules are not a playable rebuilt ROM; naming/structure consolidation remains ongoing and reported counters have different denominators.

decisions.title: NDS Decompilation Project Maker — analysis-project generator
decisions.reason: Extracts ARM7/ARM9/overlay memory sections and generates XML analysis projects with optional symbols/I/O labels. Optional BSS filling creates modeled placeholder bytes, not recovered original initialized data.

decisions.title: SMS tools — BIOS and cartridge-header patching
decisions.reason: Narrow scripts extract the Snail Maze path from a particular 8 KiB v1.3 BIOS and inject an export-cartridge header. Hardcoded layout/checksum assumptions are not a general arbitrary-ROM repair service.

decisions.title: Gemini 2 — recovered Atari desktop sources
decisions.reason: Historical Gemini 2 source snapshot recovered from an old Atari TT, including native TOS/GEM support code. Preservation of a snapshot does not establish a clean modern build or completeness.

decisions.title: PICT Extractor — Macintosh picture-resource viewer
decisions.reason: Browser parser handles PICT resource/file framing, PackBits and selected drawing records. Inspected implementation contains unfinished/debugging notes; do not infer complete QuickDraw opcode fidelity from picture extraction.

decisions.title: afp — portable Macintosh fork and Finder-info library
decisions.reason: Provides resource-fork and Finder-info access across native named forks, extended attributes and Windows AFP streams. Despite the name, it is not an Apple Filing Protocol network server.

decisions.title: BeebAsm — BBC-style cross assembler
decisions.reason: Portable 6502-family assembler with BBC BASIC-like directives, loops and expressions; writes assembled files directly into DFS SSD/DSD images and can create boot entries.

decisions.title: BBC assembly examples — Alastair Montgomery
decisions.reason: Reusable Mode 7 routines and small standalone examples, plus translated examples from Discovering BBC Micro Machine Code. This is an educational code library, not a fork or alternative implementation of the BeebAsm assembler.

decisions.title: LessNick/Amiga-WorkBench-Re-Design
decisions.reason: Inspected root is chiefly Workbench icon/theme assets and bundled utilities, with small icon-generation command workflows. No distinct reversing/restoration implementation established; do not misclassify packaged binaries as available utility source.

decisions.title: paulbowler/MAL-6502
decisions.reason: An early read/echo loop and string helpers are present, but lexer and parser return immediately. Retain the project lead without advertising a functioning Lisp interpreter.

decisions.title: l1145a1/YOBJ-PSP-File-Structure-Documentation
decisions.reason: Detailed format notes with unknown fields, but no parser implementation, named game/version verification or validation corpus established. Retain as a format-research source rather than a working general PSP model toolkit.

decisions.title: Emacs m68k mode — Amiga assembly integration
decisions.reason: Editing mode integrates m68k-lsp, an opt-in cycle counter and experimental uae-dap. Cycle-count overlays are manually refreshed; broader retro-platform support is a plan, not a verified feature.

decisions.title: mglDebugger — AmigaOS 4 MiniGL interception
decisions.reason: Small native MiniGL interface-hooking experiment logs selected context calls and restores hooks after a timed interval. Sparse repository description must not be interpreted as a full source-level debugger.

decisions.title: Foxy's Run — native Amiga platformer source
decisions.reason: Native ACE-based homebrew with gameplay, collision, entities, UI and packed converted assets; also offers an SDL host build. Source is C11, with 68000 code and AGA features off.

decisions.title: Modern m68k toolchains — six minimal language ports
decisions.reason: Proof-of-concept Rust/Swift/Zig native alert programs for TOS and classic Mac. Inline trap glue and packaging are implemented, but runtime/standard-library facilities are deliberately absent. Complete hello-world demonstrations are not production-ready full toolchains.

decisions.title: MagSID Xplatform — cross-platform C64 tracker continuation
decisions.reason: Avalonia adaptation shares tracker/DAW code, emulated playback and a native SID exporter. Retro sound bank is still incomplete; MP3/FLAC export remains Windows-only while WAV is cross-platform.

decisions.title: SwinSID Nano — reconstructed replacement-chip firmware
decisions.reason: Reconstructs three SwinSID firmware variants including the Lazy Jones fix and an unreleased variant with reported glitches. This is AVR SID-replacement firmware, not C64-executed 6510 game code.

decisions.title: SpectNetIDE — Spectrum Visual Studio development environment
decisions.reason: Integrated emulator, assembly/BASIC development and code discovery. V2 targets VS2019 rather than inheriting V1 VS2017 compatibility; Next support and some BASIC-debugging capabilities remain incomplete.

decisions.title: Z80nDisassembler — Spectrum Next instruction listings
decisions.reason: Table/bitfield instruction decoder emits addresses, instruction bytes and mnemonics including indexed forms. It is a listing tool, not a complete interactive code/data recovery framework.

decisions.title: CPR tool — CPC cartridge image assembly
decisions.reason: Single substantive script inspects AMSDOS headers and combines inputs into banked RIFF/AMS! CPR output. Missing README does not mean no implementation, but plural repository name is not evidence of a larger suite.

decisions.title: CPC music-player benchmark suite
decisions.reason: Converts music into replay formats and compares executable sizes including buffers, boilerplate and generated code. General execution-duration collection is future work; only limited FAP timing is automatic.

decisions.title: A2USB — Apple II USB mouse-interface firmware
decisions.reason: Alternate Pico/A2VGA firmware emulates the Apple II Mouse Interface Card protocol for USB HID mice instead of VGA output. Source documents 6502/6805 PIA handshaking; current implementation runs on Pico, not either original CPU.

decisions.title: a2firm — Apple II firmware symbol include
decisions.reason: ca65 include supplies documented Monitor/Applesoft entry points, soft switches and zero-page names, with optional namespaces. It is a reference/header library, not reconstructed firmware executable code.

decisions.title: FNT Reconstructor — DOS MUGEN font tools
decisions.reason: Compiles/decompiles MUGEN FNT containers into graphics and text metadata, with explicit format/error handling. Decompile here means font-container extraction, not machine-code recovery.

decisions.title: Rusty PC-98 — translation utilities and assembly notes
decisions.reason: Translation workflow includes text/pointer reinsertion, halfwidth-font patches and image tools. The reported 369/369 strings are translation coverage, not full game-code reconstruction.

decisions.title: MCP-openMSX — emulator automation bridge
decisions.reason: MCP bridge controls openMSX execution, media, memory/VDP, input and snapshots with shared stdio/HTTP capabilities and documentation retrieval. It orchestrates an existing emulator rather than reimplementing MSX hardware.

decisions.title: Catweasel tools — floppy preservation and DMK conversion
decisions.reason: Reads/writes physical media through Catweasel MK1/MK3/MK4 and converts DMK/JV1/JV3. FM/MFM/RX02 formats extend beyond TRS-80; independent image converters do not require controller hardware.

decisions.title: D71/D81 Writer — Commodore 128 fast-serial version
decisions.reason: Writes images from Ultimate media to physical 1571/1581-class drives using C128 fast serial. Empty sectors are skipped and device/image mismatches are not checked.

decisions.title: Disk Duplicator 1050 — configuration and diagnostics sources
decisions.reason: ATASM source utilities configure and exercise the Atari 1050 Disk Duplicator upgrade, including SIO commands and firmware vectors. Not the drive firmware itself or a generic Atari disk imager.

decisions.title: Shin Taketori Monogatari — PC-88 BASIC protection tools
decisions.reason: Game-specific N88 BASIC decryption/encryption and extraction/insertion. Source annotates original Z80 operations; bank/address arguments and embedded keys are format-specific, not general cryptographic recovery.

decisions.title: MakeMegaCart — ColecoVision cartridge linker helper
decisions.reason: Replacement objcopy-style helper assembles banked cartridge images from SDCC linker/map output. Bank naming, segment maps and finite image buffers are explicit assumptions, not an independent complete C compiler.

decisions.title: p2tzx — ZX80/ZX81 tape-container conversion
decisions.reason: Converts ZX81 P and ZX80 O images into TZX generalized-data blocks. TZX output does not make the input a ZX Spectrum program.

decisions.title: 6809 sprite compiler — native generated blitters
decisions.reason: Native callable module compiles packed 16-color sprite data into drawing instructions, using color zero as transparency and compact LEAX skip sequences. It trades greater code size for speed.

decisions.title: nesgo — Go-based NES compilation and emulation tools
decisions.reason: Early Go-oriented NES compiler emits ca65 assembly and includes emulator and Game Genie tools. Source-level host debugging and native NES output are distinct workflows.

decisions.title: Street Fighter Alpha 2 — S-DD1-free reconstruction tools
decisions.reason: Pre-decompresses graphics and patches chip-arming sites to build 96 Mbit SFA2/Zero2 ROMs without S-DD1. Preserves side-effecting dummy stores and uses pinned hardware models; this is modified game output, not byte-identical retail ROM reconstruction.

decisions.title: Sonic R Saturn — symbol maps and format research
decisions.reason: Publishes named function maps, review records, RNC2 unpacking and screen conversion tools, but no reconstructed C or game executable. Naming all 391 functions does not prove every semantic claim.

decisions.title: texconv — Dreamcast texture creation
decisions.reason: Creates hardware texture layouts including palettes, VQ compression, mipmaps and previews. Mipmaps must be square; stride mode excludes compression/twiddling/mipmaps and cannot be used for bump/paletted data.

decisions.title: manatools — Dreamcast audio-bank analysis
decisions.reason: MPB/MDB, MLT, OSB and FOB inspection/editing with per-format support. MSB sequences are extractable but not writable; FPB DSP programs remain insufficiently understood.

decisions.title: Silent Hill — PlayStation matching decompilation
decisions.reason: In-progress original-platform reconstruction with separate executable/overlay matching. Explicitly not a PC port or port-ready codebase; naming, typed data, documentation and shiftability remain separate work after code matching.

decisions.title: N64Recomp — static MIPS-to-C recompilation toolkit
decisions.reason: Literal instruction-to-C translation uses function symbols, overlays and relocation metadata; delay slots and indirect calls require runtime support. Generated C is not manually recovered high-level game logic.

decisions.title: GoldenEye tools — assets, maps, audio and debugging
decisions.reason: Coherent GoldenEye suite contains setup/stan conversion, Gebug64 tooling, C audio utilities and a browser map viewer. It is not a completed full game decompilation.

decisions.title: PC Engine System Card — narrow-font extension
decisions.reason: Extends Super System Card 3.0 EX_GETFNT with 8x12/8x16 ASCII modes, preserving old SJIS modes. Games must explicitly detect/use the extension; this does not translate every game automatically.

decisions.title: lyxass — Lynx and Jaguar macro assembler
decisions.reason: Macro assembler includes native Jaguar GPU/DSP instruction encoding and Lynx support. Include search uses BLL_ROOT versus BJL_ROOT for different targets.

decisions.title: OptiDoom — enhanced 3DO Doom source port
decisions.reason: Enhanced continuation of original 3DO Doom sources with renderer and build/disc workflow changes. It is not a fresh disassembly or a promised byte-identical retail build.

decisions.title: OpenWitch libraries — WonderWitch SDK reimplementation
decisions.reason: Open implementation of startup code, BIOS/OS wrappers and color extensions. Generated wrapper source issues real interrupt-based calls; it is not a replacement WonderSwan game emulator.

decisions.title: Patapon PAC tools — bytecode analysis suite
decisions.reason: Parses PAC instructions, parameters and code structures for Patapon analysis. Despite the name, it does not emit high-level source, assemble PAC or emit IR; interface work remains incomplete.

decisions.title: 68000 Disassembler Skill — Mac and Atari structural analysis
decisions.reason: Substantive loaders/decoder/annotation tools accompany Claude commands: Mac resource and ROM formats, TOS PRG relocations, vectors, table recovery and vasm output. Skill packaging alone neither proves nor disproves implemented functionality.

decisions.title: Defence-Force/The-Oric-Library
decisions.reason: PHP website source for a book/magazine catalogue, not an Oric programming library or native software reconstruction. Useful research source, but do not promote the catalogue backend as a retro runtime library.

decisions.title: SimsAdvanceRet/UrbzGBADecomp
decisions.reason: Inspected tree contains only a short README announcing a WIP. No recovered source, build or analysis artifact is present at this revision; retain as a lead rather than claim a source-bearing decompilation.

decisions.title: DeuceEFI/Jaguar-Assembly-Manual
decisions.reason: Jaguar is a FreeEMS automotive PCB; assembly means hardware construction. It is unrelated to Atari Jaguar software or an assembler.

decisions.title: USEPA/msx_tools
decisions.reason: MSX means EPANET multi-species water-quality modelling, not the MSX home computer. Python implementation and README establish this false platform match.

decisions.title: RetrolariumLab/flicky_src
decisions.reason: Already tracked as flicky-mega-drive-source-reconstruction under oranguthang/flicky_src. Old API URL returns Moved Permanently to repository ID 788148376, which matches RetrolariumLab/flicky_src. Preserve renamed-owner lineage; do not create a second reconstruction entry.
